five-day holiday; a more fantastic

","

five-days holiday; a more fantastic

"]
q.analysis: 数词与名词构成的复合形容词，名词用单数形式，a five-day holiday意为“五天的假期”；第二空表示的是与其它城市相比，暗含比较级，所以用a more fantastic，故选C。

q.stem: The ____ people can always live a happier life.
q.analysis: hard-working可作复合形容词使用，表示“勤勉的、努力工作的”。

q.stem: (2019·甘肃武威二模) It takes me one hour to write an ____ article.
q.analysis: 数词与名词构成的复合形容词，名词用单数形式，an 800-word article意为“一篇800字的文章”；故选D。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
轻松的餐厅环境本身就可以给你带来更加愉快的用餐体验。(enjoy)
Relaxing restaurant atmosphere itself can bring you a m________ e________ dining experience.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据句意“更加愉快的”，所以填more enjoyable。

q.stem:
首字母填空。
Passengers are reminded to take all their p________ belongings with them when they leave the plane.
q.analysis: 根据句意，“个人物品”用personal belongings，故填personal。

q.stem:
用括号内所给单词的适当形式填空。
Now we can take the kids to the park to do something more interesting and ________ (create).
q.analysis: 空格处单词与interesting一起构成并列的后置定语，来修饰不定代词something，故把动词create改为形容词creative。

q.stem:
用括号内单词的适当形式填空。
The music sounds too ________ (noise). Turn it off, please.
q.analysis: sound是感官动词，后接形容词，因此填noisy。

m.title: 形容词的构成 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

简单形容词的构成

简单形容词的构成

简单形容词的构成

合成形容词

合成形容词

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。

(2018·江苏南京中考) Miss Li is a kind teacher and she always talks to us ________ (gentle).
q.analysis: 形容词gentle意为“温和的；文雅的”，设空处需用副词修饰动词talks，故填副词gently“温和地”。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。

(2016·山东烟台中考) The little girl is very kind and she always talks to people ________ (polite).
q.analysis: 形容词polite意为“有礼貌的”，设空处需填副词修饰动词talks，故填副词politely“有礼貌地”。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。

(2016·新疆中考) No matter what difficult problems we meet, please face them ________ (brave).
q.analysis: 形容词brave意为“勇敢的”，设空处需用副词修饰动词face，故填副词bravely“勇敢地”。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。

(2017·江苏宿迁中考) The doctor advised me to eat ________ (healthy) and exercise a lot.
q.analysis: 形容词healthy意为“健康的”，设空处需用副词修饰动词eat，故填副词healthily“健康地”。

q.stem: (2020·安徽中考模拟) There is something wrong with my nose, so I can ____ smell everything.
q.analysis: always意为“总是”，hardly意为“几乎不”，sometimes意为“有时候”，often意为“通常”；根据There is something wrong with my nose可知，此处应是“几乎闻不到”，故选B。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
________ (unlucky), seven of the tourists died in the accident in the US.
q.analysis: 修饰整个句子要将形容词转换成副词，unlucky的副词形式是改y为i再加-ly。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
Bob was late for work yesterday, so his boss shouted at him ________ (angry).
q.analysis: 修饰动词要将形容词转换成副词，angry的副词形式是改y为i再加-ly。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
许多英国的词汇没有在美国广泛地使用。
A lot of British words aren't ________ ________ in the United States.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: be widely used表示“被广泛地使用”。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
I feel like sitting ________ (comfortable) on sofa watching TV on weekends.
q.analysis: 修饰动词要将形容词转换成副词，comfortable的副词形式是词尾e改y。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
The experience in Australia in July was ________ (true) unforgettable.
q.analysis: 修饰形容词要将形容词转换成副词，true的副词形式是去e加-ly。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
This is ________ (simple) a matter of time.
q.analysis: 修饰动词is用副词，simple的副词形式是词尾e改y。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
What nice weather! The sun is shining and the wind blows ________ (gentle).
q.analysis: 修饰动词要将形容词转换成副词，gentle的副词形式是词尾e改y。

m.title: 副词的构成 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

形容词变副词

形容词变副词

口诀

本身是副词

本身是副词

q.stem: The tourists travelled around London ____.
q.analysis: 修饰动词要用副词，排除CD。free作副词“免费地”，freely副词“自由地”，根据句意，选A。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
她今天起床太晚了以至于错过了首班公交车。
She got up ________ ________ that she missed the first bus.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 关键词是that，可知用so+adj./adv. that的结构，表示“如此以至于”；所以填so late，此处late是一个副词。

q.stem: (2014·江苏无锡中考) The shop owner suddenly stopped talking with his mouth ________ like a big "o". It was the president.
q.analysis: tightly closed是“紧闭”的意思，根据句意，排除AB。wide作副词表示“张大；睁大”，widely主要表示距离远、范围大、地域广等。 故wide open符合句意，选C。

q.stem: (2017·四川宜宾中考) It is ________ for him to get to school on time, because it is raining ________.
q.analysis: hard既可以作形容词也可以作副词。第一空作形容词表示“困难的”，第二空作副词，形容雨下得大；hardly是“几乎不”的意思，根据句意选C。

q.stem: (2020·黑龙江哈尔滨一模) There is no doubt that we can ____ succeed without our teachers’ ____ work, encouragement, love and care. So please show our respect for our teacher at any time.
q.analysis: 副词hardly意为“几乎不”，形容词兼副词hard意为“努力的（地）；困难的（地）”；第一个空需用副词hardly修饰动词succeed，第二个空用形容词hard修饰名词work，故选A。

q.stem: (2017·江苏徐州二模) The coach thought ____ of Mary’s sports talents, for she jumped very ____ at the sports meeting.
q.analysis: 副词highly意为“高度地；非常；非常赞许地”，形容词兼副词high意为“高的（地）”；thought highly of意为“高度评价”，第二空需用副词high修饰动词jump，故选B。

q.stem: We have been to the China Folk Culture Villages ____.
q.analysis: lately“最近地”，late“晚的(地)；迟的(地)”，latest“最新的，最近的”，last“最后的，上一个的”，根据句意，最近去过中国民俗文化村，故选A。

q.stem: I am ____ grateful to you for your kindness.
q.analysis: 修饰形容词要用副词，deeply“深深地”。

q.stem: She opened the door ____ so that the room was light.
q.analysis: wide作副词，意为“充分地、广阔地”；widely作副词，意为“广泛地”。C符合句意。

q.stem:
-How are you ____?
-I'm fine. And you?
q.analysis: 修饰整个句子用副词，lately“最近”。

q.stem: Do you see that butterfly flying ____ above the street?
q.analysis: 修饰动词要用副词，故排除CD。high作副词，表示具体意义的高，highly表示抽象意义的高。本题指“飞得高”，故选A。

q.stem: You don't have to pay the tickets for your kids. Children under five travel ____.
q.analysis: free副词，免费地；freely副词，自由地。B符合句意。

q.stem: She is a ____ educated woman.
q.analysis: 修饰形容词要用副词，educated“受过教育的”，highly educated"受教育程度很高的"。

m.title: 形、副同形的单词 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

特别注意

q.stem: (2016·贵州贵阳中考) Paul stayed up late to watch the soccer game last night and now he feels very ____.
q.analysis: sleep动词“睡觉”，asleep形容词“睡着的”，sleepy形容词“困倦的”。feel是系动词，后跟形容词，排除A。根据句意Paul stayed up late to watch the soccer game last night可知现在的状态是困倦而不是睡着，故选C。

q.stem:
请根据形容词排列规则填空。
Jack's father has ________ ________ (black, curly) hair.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 有多个形容词修饰名词的时候，顺序为外观、色彩，所以填curly black。

q.stem: (2019·黑龙江哈尔滨中考) Learning is a lifelong journey because we can learn ________ every day.
q.analysis: 形容词修饰不定代词时，需后置，肯定句用something，故选C。

q.stem: (2019·辽宁中考) His grandfather did his best to keep the tree ____，but it died in the end.
q.analysis: alive“活着的”；asleep“睡着的”；absent“缺席的”；awake“醒着的”；根据意思“他的祖父尽了最大努力使这棵树活下来，但最后树还是死了”，可知用alive，故选A。

q.stem:
(2015·四川凉山中考) -The fish tastes ____, and we have eaten it up.
-It is certain that she cooked it ____.
q.analysis: 根据tastes，可知这是感官动词，感官动词后用形容词，故第一个空用good。根据cooked it可知此处需要副词well，修饰动词cook，故选A。

q.stem: (2019·江苏常州中考) In the library, students are required to keep ____ and move ____.
q.analysis: keep系动词，后面加形容词quiet；move是动词，副词修饰动词，故用副词quietly。故选B。

q.stem:
(2020·安徽滁州中考模拟) -Did you do ____ this Sunday?

-No, I did my homework at home as usual.
q.analysis: 形容词修饰不定代词时，需后置，所以排除C和D；something常用于肯定句中，在否定句或疑问句中需用anything替代，同时，anything还有“任何事”之意，此处表示“一些特别的事”，是疑问句，故选B。

q.stem: (2020·江苏初三一模) She bought a ____ statue from that shop.
q.options:
["

beautiful red African wooden

","

red African wooden beautiful

","

wooden beautiful red African

","

beautiful wooden red African

"]
q.analysis: 当有许多修饰词修饰名词时，顺序是限定词、描绘类、形状类、时间类、颜色类、出处类、材料类、用途类（限定描绘大长高，形状年龄和新老；颜色国籍跟材料，作用类别往后排），故选A。

q.stem: (2018·四川成都入学考) Zanx has a ____ car. It's the New Year gift from her parents.
q.options:
["

cool black French

","

old yellow American

","

blue beautiful English

","

Chinese expensive new

"]
q.analysis: 当有许多修饰词修饰名词时，顺序是限定词、描绘类、形状类、时间类、颜色类、出处类、材料类、用途类（限定描绘大长高，形状年龄和新老；颜色国籍跟材料，作用类别往后排），故选A。

q.stem:
请根据形容词排列规则填空。
She has a ________ ________ ________ (leather,brown,beautiful) jacket.
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 有多个形容词修饰名词的时候，顺序为外观、色彩、材料，所以填beautiful brown leather。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。

(2018·北京期中) 发现博物馆关门了，我们很失望。

We were disappointed to find the museum ________.
q.analysis: 短语“find sth.+adj.”意为“发现某物怎么样”，形容词closed意为“关着的”，故填closed。

q.stem: (2016·浙江湖州期中) John was so sleepy that he could hardly keep his eyes ____.
q.analysis: 短语“keep sb./sth.+adj.”意为“使某人/某物怎么样”，形容词open意为“开着的；睁开的”，故选A。

q.stem:
(2016·江苏徐州期中) -Why are there so many people buying this kind of cake?

-Because this kind of cake looks ____ and sells ____ in the shop.
q.analysis: 第一个空前looks是系动词，表示“看起来”，后面需跟形容词作表语，所以排除C；动词sells是实义动词，需用副词修饰，故选A。

q.stem:
首字母填空，每空一词。

(2019·上海黄浦一模) The pain in my back was hard to bear and even the b________ tasks became difficult.
q.analysis: 设空处需填形容词修饰名词tasks，根据语境及首字母可知，此处应是even the basic tasks“甚至最基本的工作”，形容词basic意为“基本的；基础的”，故填basic。

q.stem:
(2020·江苏淮安期末) -Do you have your winter plan, Bill?

-Well. I want to go ____ to relax with my family.
q.analysis: 形容词修饰不定副词或不定代词时，需后置，所以排除A；somewhere“某个地方；在某处”常用于肯定句中，在否定句或疑问句中需用anywhere替代；同时，anywhere还有“任何地方”之意，此处表示“一个有趣的地方”，是肯定句，故选C。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。
Being too busy every day will make one ________ (forget) sometimes.
q.analysis: make sb./sth.+adj.“使某人/物/事处于某种状态”。forget的形容词形式是forgetful“健忘的”。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词，首字母已给。
现在，许多人，尤其是年轻人喜欢在微信里分享自己的个人信息。
Nowadays, a lot of people, especially the young people are fond of sharing their p________ i________ on wechat.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: personal informationb表示“个人信息"；personal形容词修饰information。

m.title: 形容词的用法 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

特别注意

特别注意

q.stem:
(2019·贵州铜仁市中考) -We shouldn't worry about Mary.
- You are right. She is ____ to look after ____.
q.options:
["
old enough; herself
","
big enough; herself
","
enough old; her
","
enough big; her
"]
q.analysis: 当enough修饰形容词或副词时，enough应放在形容词、副词之后，即可排除CD，形容年龄大用old。第二空考查look after oneself“照顾某人自己”，故选A。

q.stem: (2015·甘肃庆阳中考) Don't worry. He is ____ to take care of little Betty.
q.analysis: enough修饰形容词、副词要后置，排除BD；空格部分放在系动词后作表语，所以要用形容词，故选C。

q.stem:
(2019·湖北襄阳中考模拟) -Jim, we have to drive ____ to get to school on time.

-No hurry, dad. Safety is the most important thing.
q.analysis: 当enough修饰形容词或副词时，enough应放在形容词、副词之后，即可排除CD；此处修饰动词drive，应用副词fast，故选A。

q.stem:
(2018·湖北荆州中考) -I'II be away for a long time.

-Don't worry. She can look after your pet ____.
q.analysis: 当enough修饰形容词或副词时，enough应放在形容词、副词之后，即可排除BD两项；此处修饰动词短语look after，应用副词carefully，选C。

q.stem: He did not write ____, though he had ____.
q.options:
["

careful enough; enough time

","

carefully enough; enough time

","

enough careful; enough time

","

enough careless; time enough

"]
q.analysis: enough作形容词修饰名词时，置于名词前；enough作副词修饰形容词或副词时，放在所修饰词之后；即可排除CD。第一空修饰动词write，应用副词carefully。故选B。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
我有足够的时间来完成这份工作。
I have ________ time ________ finish the work.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据中文意思结合英语句子可知空格处应填写内容“足够......来......”相对应的结构应是enough...to do...，故空格应填写enough;to。

q.stem:
根据中文填空，每空一词。
The boy isn't ________ ________ (岁数足够大) to go to school.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: old enough表示“岁数足够大”；形容词和副词放在enough前面。

q.stem:
根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
-Why does the girl always have a cold?
-I’m afraid she doesn’t ________ ________ ________ (穿足够多的衣服).
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: wear enough clothes，表示“穿足够多的衣服”。

q.stem:
根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
-Why do I always have a fever?
-You don’t have ________ ________ (有足够的锻炼), I’m afraid. And don’t forget to wear enough clothes.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: have/do enough exercise，做/有足够多的锻炼。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
虽然这些书很重，但汤姆足够强壮可以搬动他们。
Although these books are heavy, Tom is ________ ________ ________ ________ them.
（本题共 4 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: “足够……以致于能够……”用“adj. + enough + to do”表示。

m.title: enough的用法 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem: (2017·新疆乌鲁木齐中考) ____ teenagers are becoming the "Head-down Tribe"(低头族). It's ____ bad.
q.options:
["
Too many; much too
","
Too much; too much
","
Much too; too much
","
Too many; too much
"]
q.analysis: too many“太多”，修饰可数名词复数；too much“太多”，修饰不可数名词；much too“太”，表示程度，修饰形容词或者副词。第一个空修饰可数名词复数teenagers，故用too many，第二个空表示程度，修饰形容词bad，故用much too。故选A。

q.stem: (2018·内蒙古通辽中考) The old couple were ____ because they had a ____ trip in Australia.
q.analysis: 第一个空，作表语用形容词pleased“高兴的”；第二个空，作定语用pleasant“愉快的”。故选B。

q.stem: (2017·山东菏泽中考) She lived ____ in a small village, but she didn't feel ____.
q.analysis: 根据lived，可知其后需要副词alone修饰，含义为“独自一人居住”。根据feel，可知这是感官动词，其后需要形容词，alone作形容词时，含义为“单独的”，侧重说明独自一人，没有感情色彩，而形容词lonely表示主观上感到孤独、寂寞的，有较浓的感情色彩，故此处用形容词lonely，故选B。

q.stem: (2017·黑龙江龙东地区中考) My cousin is ____ heavy because he often eats ____ fast food.
q.options:
["

much too; too many

","

too much; too much

","

much too; too much

"]
q.analysis: too much的中心词是much，后跟不可数名词，意思是“太多的”；much too的中心词是too，修饰形容词或副词，意思是“非常，太”；too many“太多的”，中心词是many，后跟可数名词复数。第一空修饰形容词heavy，第二空修饰不可数名词fast food，故选C。

q.stem: (2011·甘肃兰州中考) He said he would come to see us ____ the next afternoon.
q.analysis: sometime“某个时间”，some time“一段时间”，sometimes“有时”，some times“几次”；根据语境，“他将在第二天下午的某个时间来看我们”，选A。

q.stem:
(2013·山东泰安中考) -I am not sure which tie to wear for the party.

-God! I have no idea, ____.
q.analysis: too“也”，用于肯定句的末尾；neither“（两者）都不”；either“也”，用于否定句的末尾；also“也”，用于句子中间。句中I have no idea为否定句，故答案为C。

q.stem: (2015·江苏徐州期末) I know this shopping mall very ____.
q.analysis: 设空处需填副词修饰动词know，good，great和nice都是形容词，well是副词，故选B。

q.stem: His grandparents live ____ in a small house, but they don't feel ____.
q.analysis: lonely表示“心灵上的孤独”，alone表示“状态上一个人”。前者作为形容词使用，后者可作为副词修饰动词。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填单词。
Have you seen this film ________ (之前，以前)?
q.analysis: before泛指从过去起的若干时间以前，意思是“距过去某时……以前”，常和完成时连用。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思完成句子，每空一词。
Now I am at home. But I was in the office ________ ________ ________ (三小时之前).
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 是以现在为节点的三小时前，用three hours ago。

q.stem:
(2019·江苏南京期末) -Would you like a pair of new shoes?

-No, I think they cost ____. They are ____ expensive.
q.options:
["

too much; too much

","

too much; much too

","

too many; much too

","

much too; much too

"]
q.analysis: too much意为“太多”，修饰不可数名词或动词；much too意为“太；非常”，修饰形容词或副词；too many修饰可数名词复数；第一个空cost too much意为“花太多钱”，第二个空much too expensive意为“太贵”，故选B。

q.stem:
根据句意和汉语提示写出单词。
Chinese clay art (中国泥塑艺术) is famous because the clay pieces are so small but they look very ________ (真的).
q.analysis: real表示“真的”，符合题意。

q.stem:
根据句意和汉语提示写出单词。
What he says is ________ (真的). You can believe (相信) him.
q.analysis: true表示“真的”，符合题意。

q.stem: (2019·江苏苏州期中) It is ____ that this is a ____ tiger.
q.analysis: real当“真的”来讲，含有“客观存在的”之意，即“看得见，摸的着”；true意为“确实的；真实的”，表示“符合实际的，与事实相符的”，修饰抽象名词时，常用true；第一个空表示“与事实相符”，用true；第二个空表示“真的老虎”，用real，故选D。

q.stem: (2020·江苏泰州期中) If you want to make a fruit salad, you should choose fruit ____ and never leave it in the air for ____ or it’ll turn brown quickly.
q.options:
["

in a season; sometime

","

in season; some time

","

in the season; sometimes

","

in season; some times

"]
q.analysis: in season意为“当季的；应时的”；some time意为“一段时间”，sometimes意为“有时候”，sometime意为“改天；来日；在某一时候”，some times意为“几次”；第二空表示“停留一段时间”，用some time，故选B。

q.stem: (2011·甘肃兰州中考) He said he would come to see us ____ the next afternoon.
q.analysis: sometime“某个时候”；some time“一些时间，一段时间”；sometimes“有时”；some times“许多次”。根据“see us ____ the next afternoon”可知是在明天下午某个不确定的时间，所以要用sometime。

q.stem:
(2019·江苏泰州中考) -How about the fruit salad?
-Yummy! It tastes very ____. By the way, who made it?
q.analysis: good “好的”，形容词；bad “坏的，糟糕的”，形容词；well “好地”，副词；badly “糟糕地”，副词。taste “尝起来”，系动词，后跟形容词作表语，再通过Yummy可判断沙拉是好吃的，因此用good 符合题意。

q.stem: I heard that Jim's father wanted to send him to the US for ____ education.
q.analysis: farther和further都是far的比较级，两者都可表示有形距离的“较远”，但只有further可表示程度上“更多的”。这里指进一步教育，用further。CD项是最高级，不用在此空中。

q.stem: The newly bought microwave oven has failed to work ____.
q.analysis: sometimes是频率副词，意为“有时，间或”；some times是名词词组，意为“几次，几倍”；sometime是副词，意为“某时”；some time是名词词组,意为“一段时间”。根据句意，选D。

q.stem: Our school is ____ larger than theirs.
q.analysis: sometimes是频率副词，意为“有时，间或”；some times是名词词组，意为“几次，几倍”；sometime是副词，意为“某时”；some time是名词词组,意为“一段时间”。根据句意，选D。

m.title: 易混形容词副词(短语)辨析 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

alone 和 lonely

quick, fast 和 soon

good 和 well

ill 和 sick

pleased 和 pleasant

real 和 true

ago, before

q.stem: The computer game is very ____ and many children are ____ in it.
q.analysis: 第一空，修饰game，用interesting“有趣的”；第二空，be interested in sth. “对……感兴趣”，故选D。

q.stem: We are ____ to hear that the girl can run at an ____ speed.
q.analysis: amazing指“令人感到震惊的”，往往用来形容物；amazed指“（感到）震惊的”，往往用来形容人。故选B。

q.stem: Our teacher is ____ with our study last term.
q.analysis: satisfied表示“感到满意的”，be satisfied with为固定搭配，意为“对……感到满意”。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。
(2012·甘肃兰州中考) The movie was interesting, but Grace was not ________ (interest) in it.
q.analysis: interested“感到有趣的”，interesting“令人感到有趣的”。本空的主语Grace是人，故用interested来修饰。be interested in“对……感兴趣”为固定短语，故答案为interested。

q.stem: (2018·黑龙江鹤岗中考) We are ____ about the ____ news that Beijing will hold the Winter Olympics in 2022.
q.analysis: 一般ing形容词修饰物，ed形容词修饰人，第一个空修饰we，是人，第二个空修饰news，是物，故选A。

q.stem:
(2017·贵州安顺中考) -Why are you so happy, Mr. Wu?
-Because the movie yesterday evening was so ____ and it made me____.
q.analysis: moving表示“令人感动的”，修饰物；moved表示“使人感动的”，修饰人。根据题干可知吴先生开心是因为昨晚的电影令人很感动，则第一空填写moving，第二空表示电影使吴先生很感动，则此处填写moved，故选择B。

q.stem:
(2018·黑龙江哈尔滨中考) -I want to take part in after-class activities.
-So do I. I think these activities can make us feel ____.
q.analysis: 根据 I think these activities can make us feel可知此处修饰us。relaxing修饰物，relaxed修饰人，故选C。

q.stem: (2019·云南中考) We're very ____ about the graduation ceremony next Saturday. We can't wait to be there.
q.analysis: boring“令人无聊的”，常修饰物；bored“感到无聊的”，常修饰人；excited“感到激动的”，常修饰人；excting“令人激动的”，常修饰物。主语是We，再根据“我们等不及要去那里了”，选项C符合题意。

q.stem: (2019·吉林长春期末) My grandma prefers the movie ____ has a happy ending and makes her ____.
q.options:
["

which; to relax

","

that; to relax

","

that; relaxed

","

whose; relaxing

"]
q.analysis: the movie后面是一个定语从句，先行词是物，关系词在从句中作主语，需用that或which引导，所以排除D；“make sb.+adj.”意为“使某人怎么样”，形容词relaxed意为“感到放松的”，常用于修饰人；relaxing意为“令人放松的”，常用于修饰事物；此处修饰her，故选C。

q.stem: The fans were so ____ to know their favorite singing star Whitney Houston's death.
q.analysis: surprised“感到惊讶的”，用来形容人；surprising“令人惊讶的”，用来形容事物，选C。

q.stem: The ____ activity made people feel ____.
q.analysis: tiring用来形容事，“使人感到累的”；tired用来形容人，“人感到累的”。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
你能推荐我一下令人放松的音乐吗？我想要放松一下自己。
Could you recommend me some ________ music? I want to make myself ________.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: relaxing表示“令人放松的”；relaxed表示“感到放松的”。

q.stem: Poor boy! His ____ looks and ____ hands suggested he was very afraid.
q.analysis: frightful“可怕的”；frightening “令人害怕的”，frightened“感到害怕的”；trembling “颤抖着的”。B符合句意。

m.title: -ed与-ing形容词辨析 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem: It's ____ to know the weather of the new place on the Internet before you travel there.
q.analysis: A糟糕的；B有害的；C有帮助的；D强大的、有影响力的。C符合句意。

q.stem: He has read many books on history, so it's ____ for him to answer these questions.
q.analysis: 既然读了很多相关方面的书，回答出问题自然是不难的。故用easy“容易的”。hard“困难的”，impossible“不可能的”，serious“严重的”，均不符合句意。

q.stem: Mom told me, "It's ____ play with fire."
q.analysis: it's+adj.+to do sth.表示“做某事是……的”，故选B。

q.stem:
(2019·天津中考) -Diana, I forget new words quickly. How can I remember them?

-Don't worry. It's ____ to forget new words! I suggest you read the words and try to use them.
q.analysis: rude意为“粗鲁的；无礼的”，exciting意为“令人兴奋的”，perfect意为“完美的；最好的”，natural意为“自然的；物质的；天生的”；此处应是表示“忘记单词是自然的事”，故选D。

q.stem:
首字母填空。
(2014·湖北恩施中考) It is n ________ for you to finish your work in time every day.
q.analysis: 根据句子的关键词“每天及时地完成工作”应该是很“有必要的”，故填necessary。

q.stem: (2017·重庆市渝北区中考) It isn't easy for us ____ English well.
q.analysis: 由设空处前面的It isn't easy for us 判断此题考查句式“It's+形容词+(for sb.) to do sth.”； 所以选D。

q.stem: (2013·甘肃定西中考) ____ is really hard ____ them to climb such a high mountain.
q.analysis: 结合句子结构这里用it作为形式主语，动词不定式作为真正主语，构成句型it's+adj.+for sb.+to do sth.“对某人来说做某事是怎样的”，故答案是D。

q.stem: (2014·广西北海中考) It is very ____ for students to read good books．
q.analysis: careful“仔细的”；helpful“有帮助的”；easily“容易地”；hardly“几乎不”；根据句中的read good books推测出“对学生是非常有帮助的”；故选B。

q.stem: It's ____ you to help me with my housework.
q.analysis: “It is＋adj.＋of sb. to do sth.” 用of而不是for，表现人的性格、品质或特点。故选B。

q.stem: (2017·重庆月考) It is ____ you to speak ____ in public.
q.options:
["

polite for; aloud

","

polite of; loud

","

impolite for; loudly

","

impolite of; loudly

"]
q.analysis: polite意为“礼貌的”，impolite意为“不礼貌的”；此处应是“大声说话是不礼貌的”，所以排除A和B；句型“It's+adj.(表示人品质的形容词)+of sb. to do sth.”意为“某人做某事体现了怎样的品质”，句型“It's+adj.(描述事情的形容词)+for sb. to do sth.”意为“做某事对某人来说是怎样的”，此处impolite指人的品质，故选D。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词，首字母已给。
能想出这个办法，你真是太聪明了。
It's s________ ________ you to think out this way.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据搭配it is + adj. for/of sb. to do，形容词修饰to do用for sb., 形容词修饰sb.的品格用of sb.。所以填smart of。

q.stem: It was lucky ____ us ____ the last bus that night.
q.options: ["for; catch","for; to catch","of; catch","of; to catch"]
q.analysis: “It is＋adj.＋of sb. to do sth.”用of表现人的性格、品质或特征； “It is＋adj.＋for sb. to do sth.”用for表示说话人对客观事件的决断性。本题lucky修饰“赶上末班车”这件事，故选B。

q.stem: It's clever ____ you ____ the highest score in your class.
q.options: ["of; get","of; to get","for; get","for; to get"]
q.analysis: “It is＋adj.＋of sb. to do sth.” 用of表现人的性格、品质或特征； “It is＋adj.＋for sb. to do sth.”用for表示说话人对客观事件的决断性，本题中“聪明”指人的品质和特点，故选B。

q.stem: Travellers may think it is uncomfortable ____ them ____ with too much belongings.
q.options: ["of; travel","of; to travel","for; travel","for; to travel"]
q.analysis: “It is＋adj.＋of sb. to do sth.”用of表现人的性格、品质或特征； “It is＋adj.＋for sb. to do sth.”用for表示说话人对客观事件的决断性。本题中uncomfortable指“随身携带太多物品旅行”这件事，故选D。

m.title: it is/was+形容词(+of/for sb.)+to do sth. · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem:
(2016·湖北襄阳中考) -______ are the students in your class?
-Most of them are only fourteen.
q.analysis: how long问的是多长时间，主要是对一段时间进行提问，答语通常是(For) three days/weeks/months等时间段；How old多大，一般针对年龄提问；how many问多少，其后跟可数名词复数；how often多久一次，回答一般是表频率的短语；根据答语Most of them are only fourteen可知上文应该是问：多大年龄？应该用How old，故选B。

q.stem:
(2019· 贵州铜仁中考) -How often do you usually go to work by subway?
- ____. I always take a bus, because there is no subway in this city.
q.analysis: Sometimes有时；Often经常；Never从不；Seldom很少。根据I always take a bus, because there is no subway in this city可知选C。

q.stem:
(2012·湖北荆州中考) -How ____ will the boss be back?

-In these days.
q.analysis: how far“多远”，询问距离；how soon“多久以后”，主要用来对表示将来的一段时间提问；how Iong“多长时间，多长”，对一段时间或长度提问；how often“多久一次”，询问频率。根据答句In these days可知问的是“老板多久会回来”，选B。

q.stem:
(2018·广东惠州中考一模) -____ is it from the factory to your house?

-Five minutes' walk. I go there on foot every day.
q.analysis: how many“多少”，提问数量；how long“多长，多长时间”；how soon“多久以后”；How far“多远”。根据回答Five minutes' walk可知问的是“从工厂到你家有多远”，选D。

q.stem:
(2011·广东深圳中考) -____ will she stay here?

-For ____.
q.options:
["

How soon; one hour and a half

","

How long; one and a half hours

","

How soon; one and half hours

","

How long; one hour and half

"]
q.analysis: “一个半小时”有两种表达：one hour and a half或one and a half hours。how Iong“多长时间”，对一段时间提问；how soon“多久以后”，主要用来对表示将来的一段时间提问，答语常用“in+一段时间”。题干答句是“for+时间段”表示一段时间，故选B。

q.stem:
-Planting trees is good for the environment. ____ will we plant trees on the hill?

-Maybe in two weeks.
q.analysis: how soon“多久以后，再过多久”，主要用来对表示将来的一段时间提问；how often“多久一次”，对频率进行提问；how Iong“多长时间，多长”，对一段时间或长度提问；How much“多少”，对不可数名词的数量提问和对价格提问；根据答语Maybe in two weeks推知上句是对将来的一段时间进行提问，故选B。

q.stem: ____ is it from Wuxi to Tokyo and how much does it ____ to fly there?
q.options:
["

How long; take

","

How far; cost

","

How soon; spend

","

How far; take

"]
q.analysis: how long“多长，多久”，对一段时间或长度提问；how far“多远”，询问距离；how soon“多久以后”；本题问的是无锡和东京的距离，应用how far，排除AC。cost和take都表示“花费”，但take一般指“花时间”，cost多指“花费金钱”，此处应用cost。答案为B。

q.stem:
选词填空。
- ________ ________ (How long/How far) will he stay in Beijing?
-About a month.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: how long表示“多久”，提问时间，how far表示是“多远”，提问距离，根据“大约一个月”可知，提问时间。

q.stem:
选词填空。
- ________ ________ (How long/How far) is it from Beijing to Tianjin?
-About 121 kilometers.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: how long表示“多久”，提问时间，how far表示是“多远”，提问距离，根据“大约121千米”可知提问距离。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填空，每空一词。
- ________ ________ (多少) meat do you want?
-One and a half kilos.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 词组how much表示“多少”，提问不可数名词。

q.stem:
选词填空。
-________ ________ (How long/How soon) will the film start?
-In 20 minutes.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: how long表示“多久”，how soon表示“多久以后”，根据“20分钟后”可知是多久以后，故答案为How soon。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
这本书我可以借多长时间？
 ________  ________ can I ________ this book?
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据汉语意思，可知横线处表示“多久”和“借”。how long对时间段提问。borrow是动词，表示“借”，但是为非延续性动词，不能与时间段连用，此时要用keep表示，故答案是How；long；keep。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填空，每空一词。
- ________ ________ (多久一次) do you have music lessons?
-Once a week.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 词组how often表示“多久一次”。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填空，每空一词。
- ________ ________ (多少) cups of coffee does that lady want?
-Eight cups.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 词组how many表示“多少”，提问可数名词复数。

m.title: how词组辨析 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem:
根据中文提示填写单词，每空一词。
(2015·江苏连云港中考) Lucy had a traffic accident on her way home. ________ (幸运地), she was not hurt, just got scared.
q.analysis: 设空处位于句首被逗号隔开，应用副词作状语；luckily作副词意为“幸运地”。

q.stem:
用括号中所给词的适当形式填空。
(2015·河北中考) I am writing to to tell you that I arrived home ________ (safe).
q.analysis: 设空处修饰动词arrived，应该用副词。safe是形容词，表示“安全的”，其副词为safely。

q.stem: (2019·青海西宁中考) The final exam is very important. We must treat it ____.
q.analysis: serious“严肃的，认真的”，作形容词，seriously为其副词形式；careless“粗心的”，作形容词，carelessly为其副词形式。修饰动词treat应该用副词形式，所以排除AC选项；根据The final exam is very important可知后句是“应该认真地对待”，选B。

q.stem:
(2019·江苏扬州中考一模) -Wechat has changed people's life in many ways.

-____. We can use it to communicate with others easily.
q.analysis: completely“完全地、彻底地”；exactly“准确地、确实如此”；probably“很可能”；possibly“可能地”。根据题干中We can use it to communicate with others easily可知说话人同意对方说的话，表示“确实如此”，选B。

q.stem:
用括号中所给词的适当形式填空。

(2018·湖北鄂州中考) I didn't want to be treated ________ (different) from anyone else.
q.analysis: 设空处修饰动词treated，应用副词。different为形容词，表示“不同的”，其副词是differently。

q.stem:
根据句意及汉语提示写单词。

The cat is lying ________ (舒适) under the tree with her eyes half-closed.
q.analysis: 设空处修饰动词lying，应用副词，comfortably作副词表示“舒服地，舒适地”。

q.stem: I think a ____ person should do everything ____.
q.analysis: polite作形容词，表示“有礼貌的”，politely为其副词形式；分析句子，第一空应用形容词修饰名词person，第二空应用副词修饰动词do，故选C。

q.stem:
在横线上填入适当的副词，使句义完整，每空一词。

Now it's seven thirty in the evening. The sun is ________.
q.analysis: 根据seven thirty in the evening可以推测后句意思是“太阳落山了”，down作副词意为“向下”，可表示“（太阳）落山”。

q.stem: We can hardly believe that you learn to dance so ____.
q.analysis: quick形容词，表示“快速的”，quickly为其副词形式；useful形容词，表示“有用的，有帮助的”，usefully为其副词形式。设空处修饰动词learn应该用副词，可排除AC；根据We can hardly believe推测后半句是“你学跳舞这么快”，故选B。

q.stem: It seems that the program was ____ designed. It's out of order from time to time.
q.analysis: fairly“公平地”；poorly“糟糕地”；possibly“可能地”；hardly“几乎不”。根据It's out of order from time to time可以推测出“这个程序设计得很糟糕”，选B。

q.stem:
在横线上填入适当的副词，使句义完整，每空一词。

She is ________ from home.
q.analysis: 根据from home可以推测句子意思是“她离开家了”，词组away from意为“离开”，符合句意。答案是away。

q.stem:
用括号中所给词的适当形式填空。

It rained so ________ (heavy) that many streets were covered with water.
q.analysis: 设空处修饰动词rained，应该用副词。heavy作形容词，表示“严重的，大量的”，其副词为heavily。

q.stem:
选择正确的单词完成句子。
Suddenly the bell on the wall rang ________ (aloud/loudly).
q.analysis: aloud强调发出的声音能被听见，意思为“出声地”或“大声地”，常与read 、call等动词连用；loudly意为“响亮地”，其基本意义与loud相同，常与ring、knock等动词连用。

q.stem:
用所给单词的正确形式填空。
After a while, we ________ (nature) started talking about the children.
q.analysis: 空格处单词修饰谓语动词started，故填副词naturally。

m.title: 副词的用法 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem: When you talk with a stranger, be ____ one thing: don't talk much about yourself.
q.analysis: be interested in“对……感兴趣”，be careful about sth. “小心……；注意……”，be good at“擅长……”，be frightened of“害怕……”。根据句意，和陌生人聊天要“注意”，故选B。

q.stem: Lily is a kind person. She is friendly ____ everyone who meets her.
q.analysis: be friendly to sb. “对某人友好”。故选C。

q.stem: Mom never gets angry ____ me although I often do something silly.
q.analysis: be/get angry with sb. “生某人的气”，故用with。

q.stem: (2018·云南中考) Don't play games on the computer all day. It's ____ to your eyes.
q.analysis: A有害的，B有用的，C有帮助的，D感谢的。结合句意，选A。

q.stem:
(2019·辽宁营口中考) -I feel a little ____ about the coming English exam．
-Take it easy. The better you prepare, the better grades you will get.
q.analysis: nervous“紧张的”；disappointed“失望的”；bored“厌烦的”；cross“交叉的”。根据“即将到来的英语考试”“放轻松”可知是“我感到有点紧张”，故选A。

q.stem: (2017·江苏无锡中考) Parents now have to train their kids to be ____ strangers so that they won't get kidnapped.
q.analysis: 根据so that they won't get kidnapped可知，此处应是be careful with strangers“要小心陌生人”，be careful with意为“小心......”，故选C。

q.stem:
(2019·广西贵港中考) -What do you think of the TV program The Reader?
-Excellent. Many people are ____ about it. They never miss it.
q.analysis: nervous“紧张的”；worried“焦虑的，担心的”；crazy“疯狂的，喜爱的”；angry“生气的”。根据They never miss it可知对节目的喜爱程度是很深的，可以用crazy进行表达，be crazy about “对…...着迷的”，故选C。

q.stem: (2018·山东东营中考) The 119 passengers are ____ Liu Chuanjian. Without him, they would probably have lost their lives.
q.analysis: be hard on意为“严厉对待”，be thankful to意为“感谢（某人）”，be friendly to意为“对…...友好”，be responsible for意为“对……负责”；根据“Without him, they would probably have lost their lives”可知，此处应是表示“乘客感谢刘传建”，故选B。

q.stem: Peng Liyuan is ____ Chinese people as a beautiful and popular singer. And now she is also the First Lady in China.
q.analysis: be known as“作为……而著名”，be proud of“为……感到自豪”，be famous for“因……而著名”，be well-known to. “被……熟知”。空格后接人，表示“为中国人所熟知”，故选D。

q.stem: We played badly in the game. Our teacher looked very ____ with our performance.
q.analysis: disappointed“失望的”，excited“兴奋的”，satisfied“满意的”，frightened“害怕的”。根据句意，选A。

q.stem: I am quite ____ the progress I made last year. I got a grade A.
q.analysis: 取得了好成绩应该是满意的，故用be satisfied with“对……感到满意的”。

q.stem:
选词填空。
The mother is ________ (worried/worriedly) about her son's safety.
q.analysis: be worried about “担心……”。故填worried。

q.stem: I am sorry ____ your window.
q.analysis: be sorry for doing sth. “为做了某事感到抱歉”。故选D。

q.stem: She is very ____ the news.
q.analysis: be surprised at sth.“对……感到惊讶的”，故选C。

m.title: 常见的be+形+介+名/动名词短语 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem:
填写形容词的比较级和最高级。
happy ________ ________
early ________ ________
healthy ________ ________
（本题共 6 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: happy，early和healthy都以“辅音字母+y”结尾，变y为i再加-er或-est。

q.stem: (2019·重庆中考) Nobody worked the math problem out. It was ____ one of all.
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的最高级。由前一句可知这道题很难，由题干中表范围的短语of all可知应用形容词的最高级，故选D。

q.stem: (2016·天津中考) A journey by train is ____ than by coach.
q.options:
["

more relaxing

","

relaxing

","

most relaxing

","

the most relaxing

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。由than可知应用比较级，故选A项。

q.stem:
(2016·重庆中考) -I think it's necessary to learn how to work in groups.

-I quite agree. Sometimes it's even ____ than grades.
q.options:
["

less important

","

more important

","

the least important

","

the most important

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级的用法。根据语境和标志词than可知选B。

q.stem: (2019·天津中考) Jenny will get up ____ than usual in order to catch the first bus.
q.analysis: 本题考査副词的比较等级。由题干中的 than 可知本空用副词的比较级，故本题选择C。

q.stem: (2011·广东广州中考) The actress is already 50, but she looks ____ than she really is.
q.options:
["

young

","

more young

","

more younger

","

much younger

"]
q.analysis: 由“than”可知考查比较级，排除A项；young为单音节词，比较级是在其后加er，即 younger，排除B项；比较级不能用more修饰，排除C项。故选D。

q.stem: The workers have finished rebuilding the road and it is ____ than before.
q.analysis: 考查形容词比较级的用法。因为后面是“than before”，所以横线处是比较级，表示“比以前更...”。wide是形容词，意为“宽阔的”，wider是形容词的比较级，the widest是形容词的最高级。故答案是B。

q.stem:
请填写形容词或副词的比较级和最高级。
successful ________ ________
meaningful ________ ________
rich ________ ________
（本题共 6 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: successful和meaningful是多音节词，它们的比较级是在前面加more，最高级在前面加most。rich是单音节词，直接在后面加-er或-est。

q.stem: Jenny looks ____ than ever before. She is wearing a diamond necklace(钻石项链) today.
q.analysis: 考查形容词比较级的用法。look在此做系动词，表示“看起来...”，后面接形容词，而C、D均为副词，排除；又因为后面是“than ever”，所以用形容词的比较级，表示“比以前更...”。beautiful是形容词原级，意为“漂亮的”，more beautiful是形容词的比较级。故答案是B。

q.stem: I study hard this term, but Tony studies much ____.
q.analysis: 考查副词比较级的用法。much后接形容词或副词的比较级，表示“更加...”。hard做副词，意为“努力地”；harder是副词的比较级；the hardest最高级。故答案是B。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。

-This shirt is too large for me. Could you show me a ________ (small) one?

-Sure.
q.analysis: 本题考查比较级。根据题干中的too large判断，需要一件“更小的”衬衫。small变为比较级时，直接在词尾加-er，smaller。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。

This one is the ________ (big) of the two houses.
q.analysis: the+比较级+of the two表示两者之中“较……”。

q.stem: It’s getting ____ outside. Summer is already here!
q.options: ["hot and hot","hoter and hoter","hotter and hotter","hot and hotter"]
q.analysis: “比较级+and+比较级”结构表示“越来越……”，hot变为比较级时，双写词尾t加-er，故选C。

m.title: 形容词和副词比较等级的规则变化 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

规则变化

q.stem:
(2019·江西中考) -What do you think of the band's performance?

-It could be ____. I think they're feeling very nervous.
q.options:
["

good

","

better

","

bad

","

worse

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。 could be better可以更好。根据语境可知，如果不紧张的话，乐队还可以发挥得更好。故选择B。

q.stem: (2018·江苏苏州中考) He was advised to eat fewer hamburgers and drink ____ cola to keep fit.
q.options:
["

much

","

more

","

fewer

","

less

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。much 许多的，修饰不可数名词；more 更多的，修饰可数名词复数和不可数名词； fewer 更少的，修饰可数名词复数；less 更少的，修饰不可数名词。cola为不可数名词，排除C项；根据句意和常识可知此处表示少喝可乐，故选D项。

q.stem:
(2015·湖北黄冈中考) -Do you know that China is one of ____ countries in the world?

-Yes, I do. It's much ____ than the US.
q.options:
["

oldest; elder 

","

the oldest; older

","

the oldest; elder

","

the older; elder

"]
q.analysis: 由“A+is one of the+形容词最高级+复数可数名词+比较范围”可知第一空应填the+形容词最高级，排除A、D两项。由第二空后的“than”可知应用比较级，old意为“古老的”时，比较级为older；意为“年老的”时，比较级为elder。故选B。

q.stem: (2011·山东青岛中考) In the piano contest, my brother didn't play well and I did ____.
q.analysis: 由句中的“and”可知前后句意并未发生转折。故选D。

q.stem:
(2011·湖北襄阳中考) -What do you think of her dancing?

-Oh, nobody else does ____.
q.analysis: 根据固定结构“否定词+比较级”意为“……中最……”，表示最高级，故选B。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空，每空一词。

The small village is even ________ (far) from here than the airport.
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级。本题由than知道是比较级。far有两个比较级farther表示“距离远”，而另一个比较级further表示“程度深”。题中表达的是距离的更加远。故填farther。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空，每空一词。

The job of doctors is to help make sick people ________. (well)
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级。本题是暗含一个比较级，医生的工作就是帮助有病的病人比以前更好一些，所以本题要用well的比较级better。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空。
With the help of the machine, people can make ________ (many) cakes than before.
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级。本题由than这个单词知道是比较级，并且想表达更多的蛋糕，所以本题要用many的比较级more。

q.stem:
用所给单词的适当形式填空，每空一词。

Tom doesn’t study hard. He has got ________ (bad) marks than last term.
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级。本题由than知道是比较级，题中表达的是他比上学期的分数更差，所以用bad的比较级worse。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。
Lily sings ________ (well). She sings ________ (well) than John, but Mary sings ________ (well) in her class.
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: sing“唱歌”是动词，所以要用副词well修饰；第二空than提示用比较级，well的比较级是better；第三空在全班进行比较用最高级，well的最高级是the best。

q.stem:
请填写形容词或副词的比较级和最高级。
ill ________ ________
good ________ ________
much ________ ________
（本题共 6 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 这三个单词的比较级和最高级是不规则的，需要记忆。ill—worse—worst；good—better—best；much—more—most。

q.stem:
请填写形容词或副词的比较级和最高级。
little ________ ________
bad ________ ________
few ________ ________
（本题共 6 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: little和bad的比较级和最高级是不规则的，需要记忆。little—less—least；bad—worse—worst。few是单音节词，比较级是fewer，最高级是fewest。

m.title: 形容词和副词比较等级的不规则变化 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

不规则变化

q.stem: I don't think the underground train runs so ____ as the train above ground.
q.analysis: 否定句用“be as/so +形容词/副词原级+ as”。

q.stem: I prefer skiing to climbing because I think climbing is not so ____ as skiing.
q.analysis: not so ... as中间用原级。

q.stem: (2017·上海中考) Alex believes he will soon be able to play chess as ____ as the computer.
q.options:
["

well

","

better

","

best

","

the best

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查副词用法。“as…as…”中间应加形容词或副词原级，意为“和……一样……”，根据句意可知，中间应加副词的原级，故本题选择A。

q.stem: (2017·天津和平模考) The model Sydney Opera House looks ____ the real one in Australia.
q.options:
["

as wonderful as

","

as wonderfully as

","

so wonderful as

","

so wonderfully as

"]
q.analysis: look是系动词，和形容词一起构成系表结构；as…as意为“和……一样”，在肯定句中的结构：“A…+as+形容词或副词原级+as+B”，在否定句中的结构：“A…+not+as/so+形容词或副词原级+as+B”，故选A。

q.stem: (2017·湖南邵阳中考) Mr. Smith said his son was as ____ as his daughter.
q.options:
["

hardworking

","

more hardworking 

","

the most hardworking

"]
q.analysis: hardworking “努力的”，形容词。由句中的“as…as”可知此空应填形容词原级。故选A。

q.stem: (2019·吉林白山一模) This dictionary is ____ that one.
q.options:
["

even more useful than 

","

as useful than

","

as more useful as

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。由题意可知，应该用比较级，useful是多音节词，比较级是加more，even在此处修饰比较级。故答案为A。

q.stem: (2010·黑龙江齐齐哈尔中考) Don't just believe the advertisement. That medicine is ____ it says.
q.options:
["

as good as

","

not as good as

","

as well as

"]
q.analysis: “not+as+形容词/副词原级+as”为同级比较结构；根据上句推知下句为否定含义，即“药并没有说得好”。故选B。

q.stem: Steve isn't as ____ as Kelly. He often makes mistakes in his writing.
q.analysis: 经常犯错，肯定是不认真，空前已有not，此处用careful。

q.stem: Will doesn't play table tennis ____ he did last year.
q.options: ["so better as","so wonderful as","as good as","as well as"]
q.analysis: 否定句用“be as/so +形容词/副词原级+ as”,排除A；修饰play，要用副词，排除B和C。

q.stem: His father is ____ he.
q.options: ["twice taller","as twice old as","as old twice as","twice as old as"]
q.analysis: 表达倍数可用“倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as”。

q.stem: The earth is ____ the moon.
q.options: ["as 49 times as size","49 times as size as","49 times the size as","49 times the size of"]
q.analysis: “A是B的X倍大”可以表达为A is X times as big as B或A is X times the size of B。

q.stem: This building is ____ that one over there.
q.options: ["as tall as twice","as twice as tall","so tall as twice","twice as tall as"]
q.analysis: 副词twice放在“as+adj.原级+as”结构之前表示“两倍的……”。

q.stem: The newly broadened square is ____ the last one.
q.options: ["four times the size of","four times as the size as","as four times the size of","four times more size as"]
q.analysis: 表达倍数可用 “倍数 + the + 计量名词 + of”。

q.stem: Is everything on the moon _____ it is on the earth?
q.options: ["so light as","as light as","as lighter as","so lighter as"]
q.analysis: 肯定句用“as+adj./adv.原级+as”表示“……和……一样……”。

m.title: 形容词和副词原级比较句型 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

特别注意

q.stem: When spring comes, the days get ____ and nights ____.
q.analysis: 春天日长夜短，排除A和D；且是与之前的日夜相比，故用比较级。

q.stem: (2019·四川成都中考) Compared with newspapers or TV, the Internet offers people ____ information.
q.options:
["

much

","

more

","

most

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。由题干中 Compared with…可知，本空用形容词的比较级形式，由此可知本题选择B。

q.stem: (2019·新疆中考) The ____ we do for other people, the ____ we will be.
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。“the+比较级…，the+比较级…”为固定结构，意为“越……，就越……”。故选C。

q.stem:
(2019·内蒙古呼和浩特中考) -He is planning to walk on the wings of a flying plane.

-What? I have never heard of ____ idea before.
q.options:
["

a crazier

","

the crazier

","

a craziest

","

the craziest

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词比较级。此处是用比较级句型表示最高级的含义，又因为本空后名词idea为可数名词单数，结合句意可知在 crazier 前应用不定冠词a，故选A项。

q.stem: (2015·江苏盐城中考) With the development of modern industry, there will be ____ living space for wild animals.
q.options:
["

fewer and fewer 

","

less and less 

","

more and more

","

bigger and bigger

"]
q.analysis: fewer and fewer 越来越少，修饰复数可数名词； less and less 越来越少，修饰不可数名词；more and more 越来越多；bigger and bigger 越来越大。根据句中的“With the development of modern industry”可推知野生动物的生存空间越来越小，living space是不可数名词。故选B。

q.stem: (2016·陕西中考) ____ you speak, ____ your English will be.
q.options:
["

The less; the more 

","

The more; the better

","

The less; the better

","

The more; the less

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查固定结构。“The+比较级，the+比较级”意为“越……，就越……”，根据句意可知答案为B项。

q.stem: ____ students have realized the importance of a foreign language.
q.options: ["More and more","Fewer and fewer","Little and little","Less and less"]
q.analysis: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。根据句意，意识到外语重要性的人应该越来越多了，所以用more and more。

q.stem:
-If there are ____ people driving, there will be ____ air pollution.
-Yes, the air will be fresher.
q.analysis: people可数，用fewer修饰；pollution不可数，用less修饰。

q.stem: The book is ____ of the two.
q.analysis: 两者之中进行比较，用“the + 比较级 + of the two”。

q.stem: Li Lei is running ____ now.
q.options: ["more and more slowly","slower and slower","slowly and slowly","more slowly and more slowly"]
q.analysis: 这里修饰动词要用副词slowly，“more and more slowly”表示“越来越慢”。

q.stem: Keep on. Don't stop. The ____ you climb, the ____ you will see.
q.analysis: 越高，视野越远；这里用“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构。故选D。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
In a busy world, managing your time is increasingly important.
It is more and ________ ________ to manage your time in a busy world.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: increasingly important=more and more important表示“越来越重要”。

q.stem: Travelling abroad is becoming ____ because of the development of the transportation.
q.options: ["easier and easier","more and more easily","much easy","easiest and easiest"]
q.analysis: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。系动词become后接形容词，故选A。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
The older you get, the more forgetful you will be. 
You will be more and more forgetful when you get ________ and ________.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 本句使用“比较级+and+比较级”结构，表示“越来越……”，more and more forgetful“越来越健忘”；older and older“越来越老”。

q.stem: I like ____ one of the two books.
q.analysis: of the two books提示用比较级；特指较旧的那本，前加the。

q.stem: Grandma's hearing is getting ____. She needs a hearing aid.
q.options: ["good and good","better and better","worse and worse","less and less"]
q.analysis: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。根据句意，需要助听器说明听力越来越差，而不是越来越好。

q.stem:
-It's smoggy these days. That's terrible!
-Yes. I hope to plant trees. ____ trees, ____ air pollution.
q.options: ["The more; the fewer","The less; the more","The less; the fewer","The more; the less"]
q.analysis: 树木多，污染自然会少；trees可数，用more“越多”修饰；pollution不可数，用less“越少”修饰。

m.title: 形容词和副词比较级比较句型 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

特别注意

q.stem: Maths is more popular than ____.
q.options: ["any other subject","all the subjects","any subject","other subject"]
q.analysis: any other + 名词单数。本题还可填all the other subjects，由于数学属于subjects内，所以一定要加other。

q.stem: Tom is stronger than ____ in his class.
q.analysis: Tom属于他的班级里的男生，单用any是指在不同范围内一个与其他的相比较。any other是同一范围内一个与其他剩余的相比较，故选A。

q.stem: We have a lovely room. It's one of ____ in the hotel.
q.analysis: “one of the + 最高级”表示“最……之一”。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
He is taller than the other students in his class.
He is taller than ________ ________ ________ in his class.
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: the other students=any other student。

q.stem:
-Which is ____,the sun, the moon or the earth?
-Of course the moon is.
q.analysis: 三者之中“最……”用“the + 最高级”。

q.stem:
(2018·云南中考) -What do you think of your junior high school life?

-I think it is one of ____ periods in my life.
q.options:
["

wonderful 

","

more wonderful 

","

much wonderful

","

the most wonderful

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查“one of+the+形容词最高级+名词复数”结构，故应该选择D项。

q.stem: (2017·北京中考) The hotel is very old. It's one of ____ buildings in the city.
q.options:
["

old

","

older

","

oldest

","

the oldest

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词最高级的用法。形容词最高级前的冠词the不能省略。故选D。

q.stem:
(2011·山东菏泽中考) -Which city is your favorite?

-Hangzhou, of course. It's the ____ place that I want to visit.
q.options:
["

worse

","

worst

","

better

","

best

"]
q.analysis: worse更差的；worst最差的；better更好的；best最好的。根据问句中的“favorite(最喜欢的)”排除A、B两项；根据空前的定冠词the可知此空应填形容词的最高级。故选D。

q.stem:
(2015·四川达州中考) -Which is the longest river in China, the Changjiang River or the Yellow River?

-The Changjiang River. The Yellow River is ____ river in China.
q.options:
["

the second longest 

","

the second longer 

","

a second longest

","

the second long

"]
q.analysis: 根据固定结构“the+序数词+形容词最高级”表示“第几最……”。故选A。

q.stem: (2017·河南中考) Miho is ____ student because she was born later than anyone else in her class.
q.options:
["

young

","

younger

","

the younger

","

the youngest

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较等级。根据句意可知此处应用形容词的最高级，故选D项。

q.stem:
-This dress is too expensive. Do you have anything else?
-Sorry, but that's the ____ one.
q.analysis: but表转折，说明这件已经是最便宜的了，用cheapest。

q.stem:
用所给形容词的适当形式填空。
The clothes in this shop are the________(cheap) in the city.
q.analysis: in the city提示用最高级；cheap是单音节词，最高级加-est。

q.stem:
-Have you ever seen Tom and Jerry?
-Sure. It is one of ____ cartoons I have ever seen.
q.analysis: “one of the+最高级”表示“最……之一”。

q.stem:
-What do you think is ____ invention in the 21st century?
-The Internet, I think. It brings us a lot of convenience (方便).
q.options: ["the least important","more important","the most important","less important"]
q.analysis: in the 21st century提示用最高级，排除B和D。根据带来很多便利判断，选C。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
The iPad is the most popular tablet computer among the young people all over the world. 
The iPad is more popular ________ ________ ________ tablet computer among the young people all over the world.
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: iPad在平板电脑的范围内，在同一范围内一个与其他剩余的相比较，用“比较级 + than any other + 名词单数”的形式，指“比其他任何一个都……”。

m.title: 形容词和副词最高级比较句型 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

特别注意

q.stem: The new mobile phone is much ____ expensive than that one.
q.analysis: “much+比较级”表示比较的程度；expensive的比较级为more expensive。

q.stem: There were a number of people out this afternoon, far ____ than last Sunday.
q.analysis: “far+比较级”表示比较的程度；many的比较级为more。

q.stem:
(2018·湖南长沙中考) -Do the twins look the same?

-No, Jane is ____ taller than Claire.
q.options:
["

little

","

more 

","

a little

"]
q.analysis: a little可修饰形容词比较级。故答案为C。

q.stem: (2017·江苏苏州中考) You are speaking too fast. Can you speak a little ____?
q.options:
["

more slowly

","

most slowly

","

more loudly

","

most loudly

"]
q.analysis: 由上句可知，说话者希望对方说话相较之前慢一点，应用比较级。故选A。

q.stem:
(2015·江苏连云港中考) -The Internet service fees are too high, and the speed is too slow.

-That's why Premier Li Keqiang asks operators(运营商) to provide ____ Internet.
q.options:
["

many cheaper and quicker 

","

very cheaper and quicker

","

more cheaper and quicker

","

much cheaper and quicker

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。many，very不能修饰形容词比较级；C项形式错误；形容词比较级可用much来修饰，故选D项。

q.stem:
(2018·四川成都中考) -Mary, do you prefer weekdays or weekends?

-Of course weekdays. Because I'm ____ on weekends.
q.options:
["

busy

","

much busier

","

the busiest

"]
q.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。句中工作日和周末为对比关系，所以用形容词的比较级。much可以修饰比较级 busier。故本题选B。

q.stem: (2010·湖北孝感中考) You are too quiet. How I hope you can be ____ outgoing.
q.options:
["

a little more 

","

too much

","

much too

","

much less

"]
q.analysis: 对比上下句可知希望对方相比之前更外向一点。考查比较级，排除B、C两项，a little和much均可修饰比较级，结合题意可知选A。

q.stem:
-What do you think of receiving and giving gifts?
-I think the art of receiving a gift is ____ than the art of giving.
q.options: ["much more difficult","very more difficult","much difficult","as difficult"]
q.analysis: than提示用比较级，排除C和D；修饰比较级，可用much等。

q.stem: These children are ____ this year than they were last year.
q.analysis: than提示用比较级；tall是单音节词，比较级为taller；修饰比较级，用much。

q.stem: It's much ____ today than it was yesterday.
q.analysis: “much+比较级”表示比较的程度；hot的比较级为hotter。

q.stem:
-Jack, how are you feeling today?
-Much ____. I think I can go to school tomorrow.
q.analysis: much提示用比较级。

q.stem: Mrs Black has got ____ instead of getting any better.
q.options: ["more bad","a little worse","much badly","a lot of worse"]
q.analysis: get后跟形容词；bad的比较为worse，a little可用来修饰比较级。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。
He was a little ________(worry) than the others.
q.analysis: than提示用比较级。注意这里be后要接形容词，worry的形容词形式是worried，比较级前加more。

q.stem:
用所给词的适当形式填空。
The speaker spoke a lot ________ (loud) so as to make himself heard a bit ________ (clearly).
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: a lot和a bit都可修饰比较级，loud比较级是louder，clearly的比较级是前加more。

m.title: 比较级的修饰语 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

q.stem: (2018·新疆乌鲁木齐中考真题) Most of the villagers took part in the Dragon Boat races ____ 9:00 a.m. ____ the morning of June 18.
q.analysis: 具体时刻前用介词at，在具体某天的早上用介词on；故选B。

q.stem: (2016·广东省中考真题) Many young people put mobile gaming ____ anything else, thinking little of their normal lives．
q.analysis: along with“和……一起”；behind“在……后面”；in front of“在……前面”，指地点方位；before“在……前面”，一般指次序或时间。根据下文“很少考虑自己的日常生活”，可以推断出他们把游戏放在生活的首位，故选C。

q.stem:
(2015·重庆中考真题) 改为同义句，每空一词。

Linda is leaving for Guangzhou when class is over．

Linda is leaving for Guangzhou ________ ________.

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据两句对比可知，此空须对前一句中的时间状语从句when class is over进行同义替换，意为“下课后”。介词after可用在名词前，意为“在……后”，故填after class。

q.stem: We traveled overnight to Paris and arrived ____ 5 o'clock ____ the morning.
q.analysis: 在具体时刻前面用介词at；the morning前一般都用介词in，如果是特指某天的早上才用介词on，比如说某个日期的早上on the morning of December 7th，句中the morning没有特指某一天的早上，所以还是用in。

q.stem: You must finish your homework ____ 10:00 p.m.. You have to sleep at that time.
q.analysis: 根据下文可知“晚上10：00后要睡觉了”可推知必须要在10:00前完成作业，故用before表示“在某时之前”，答案为B。

q.stem: It'll be a long time ____ the graduation.
q.analysis: It will be +一段时间+before...为固定句型，表示“会过多久才......”，故选B。

q.stem: Children get gifts ____ Christmas and ____ their birthdays.
q.analysis: 节日中带“day”用介词on，如on Children’s Day，其余都用介词at。后半句具体某一天前用介词on。

q.stem: The American Civil War lasted four years before the North won ____ the end.
q.analysis: in the end表示“最后，终于”；at the end of表示“在……尽头，在……结束时”；by the end of表示“到……结束时为止”。根据题意是要表达“最终”的含义，故选C。

q.stem: Did your friend send you anything ____ the end of last week?
q.analysis: at the end of表示“在……的尽头，在……的末梢”；by the end of 表示“到……时为止”（句中要用完成时）；in the end 表示“最后，终于”。根据题意是要表达“上个星期末”的含义，故选A。

q.stem: Anna lost her way ____ a rainy night and her mother was quite worried ____ her.
q.analysis: 表示在某个特定的早晨、下午或晚上要用介词on；be worried about表示“担心什么问题”，be worried with 表示“受到某事的困扰”，明显这题的意思是妈妈担心女儿，所以选B

q.stem:
用适当的介词填空。
My uncle arrived ________ the airport ________ the morning of May 3.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: arrive in接大地点，arrive at接小地点，本题中的airport是小地点，所以用介词at；the morning of May 3是具体某一天的早上，要用介词on。

q.stem: It began to rain ____ midnight.
q.analysis: 在午夜是at midnight，排除A；since接过去时间点，主句谓语动词用完成时态，排除C；till主句谓语一般是延续性动词，not...till...主句谓语一般是瞬间动词；选B表示在午夜前。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
我昨晚九点后过一点点回家。
I came back shortly ________ nine last night.
q.analysis: 根据原句意九点后过一点可知应用after。

m.title: 时间介词辨析1 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

时间点：at/on/in

时间点：at/on/in

时间前后：after/before

易混易错

易混易错

q.stem: (2019·山东青岛中考真题) The high-speed train ____ Qingdao and Beijing travels faster now. The train ride takes only about three hours.
q.analysis: 根据句意可知，此处表示“青岛和北京之间的高铁”，between…and意为“在……之间”，为固定搭配，故选D。

q.stem: (2019·湖北武汉中考真题) He wrote his phone number ____ a piece of paper.
q.analysis: on“在……上面”；for“为了”；in“在……里”；from“从……来”。“写在纸上”应用介词on，故选A。

q.stem: (2017·上海中考真题) Shirley is still waiting for her flight to New York City ____ the airport.
q.analysis: at“在（某处）”；under“在……下面”；on“在……上面”；with“和……一起”。根据句意，这里指在机场等待航班，用at，故选A。

q.stem: (2016·黑龙江龙东地区中考真题) Taiwan lies ____ the east of Fujian, ____ the southeast of China.
q.analysis: 由常识可知，台湾与福建隔海相望，但不接壤，且台湾是中国的一部分；表示两者的位置关系时，介词to表示在范围之外，且相隔有一定的距离；介词in表示前者在后者的区域范围内。故选B。

q.stem:
(2014·江苏扬州中考真题) -This problem is far ____ me, I'm afraid I can't work it out.  

- Don't worry, we will help you.
q.analysis: beyond“超出……范围”；beside“在旁边”；behind“在……后面”；between“在两者之间”。本题表示问题的难度超出能力范围，故选A。

q.stem: A team of waiters began to walk ____ the table to clean the dishes.
q.analysis: walk around，“围绕着桌子走”。

q.stem: (2020·江苏省初三一模) Look, the kite in the tall tree is quite ____ my reach, so I can't get it down.
q.analysis: within“在......内”；over“在......上方”；beyond“超过”；among“在...…中”。从文字的表层意思推断空格指风筝在高树上我够不着，故选C。

q.stem: (2020·江苏省锡山高级中学实验学校初三月考) I'm afraid Physics is completely ____ me and I have to ask you for help.
q.analysis: beyond“超出”；over“在......上面”；against“反对、与......相反”；off“离开、落下”。词组beyond sb.“非某人能力所及，超出某人的能力”，符合句意。故选A。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
Don't take more jobs than you can do.
Don't take more jobs ________ your ability.
q.analysis: 原句than（比）表比较，是比较状语从句；本句是介词短语做jobs的后置定语。beyond one's ability超越某人的能力/力所不及，根据句意结构，可知填beyond。

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。
-It's a top secret.
-Yes, I see. I will keep the secret ________ you and me.
q.analysis: between... and...“在……和……之间”，文中是在你我之间。

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。
Before 1990 there was no airline ________ the two cities.
q.analysis: 题干中是两个城市之间没有航班，两者之间用介词“between”。

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。
Not all of us know the difference ________ wheat, oats and barley.
q.analysis: 小麦，燕麦和大麦是三种东西，表示三者及三者以上之间的区别用介词among。

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。
Don't read ________ the sun. It's bad ________ your eyes.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: in the sun习惯搭配，表示“在太阳光里，在阳光下”；be bad for固定搭配，表示“对某事有坏处”。

q.stem: I don't like to sit ____ Tom's right. I would like to sit ____ the back row.
q.analysis: “在某事物左边或者右边”用介词on；表示“在第几排”用介词in 。

q.stem: There are some birds singing ____ the trees.
q.analysis: in the tree多指外界的事物或人在树上，而非树木自身所长；而on the tree则多指树自身所有，长在树上的东西。

q.stem: There are so many apples ____ that tree.
q.analysis: on the tree则多指树自身所有，长在树上的东西，苹果明显是长在树上的。

q.stem: China lies ____ the east of Asia and ____ the north of Australia.
q.analysis: 表示“前者在后者的哪个方位”的句型，一般使用三个介词in/on/to。中国在亚洲范围之内，属于亚洲，所以第一空用in；中国不在澳大利亚范围内，而且也不相邻，所以第二空用to表示位置关系。

q.stem: He is ____ the greatest scientists in the world.
q.analysis: 伟大的科学家肯定是三者以上的，所以文中他是科学家中的一员，要用介词“among”。

q.stem:
用in, on, at填空。
Bill was sitting ________ the corner of the café with his mobile phone ________ the corner of the table while his dog was waiting for him ________ the corner of the street.
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: in the corner of通常用于室内的角落；on the corner of通常表示在某物的边角之上；at the corner of通常用于室外的拐角处。

m.title: 地点方位介词辨析1 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

at/in/on

around/beyond

between/among

易混易错

易混易错

q.stem: (2019·上海中考真题) Frank held his breath ____ the water to search for his ring in the swimming pool.
q.analysis: at“在（某处）”；by“通过某种方式”；over“从……上方”；under“在……下面”。根据Frank held his breath和in the swimming pool可知一定是在水下，用介词under，答案是D。

q.stem: (2016·河南中考真题) It's so cold outside. Remember to close the door ____ you when you leave.
q.analysis: beside“在……旁边”；before“在……前”；with“用”；behind“在……后面”。 根据语境推测句子表示“记得关上你后面的门”，用介词behind，答案为D。

q.stem: (2015·广西南宁中考真题) Jim sits behind me, so I sit ____ him.
q.options:
["

at the top of

","

at the end of

","

in the middle of

","

in front of

"]
q.analysis: at the top of“在……的顶部”；at the end of“在……的末端”；in the middle of“在……中间”；in  front of“在……前面”。Jimmy在“我“后面可知“我”在他的前面，故应选D。

q.stem: Two planes are flying ____ the city.
q.analysis: fly over，固定搭配，意为“从……上飞过”。

q.stem:
同义句转换，每空一词。
The passage is above the exercises.
The exercises are _________ the passage.
q.analysis: 根据句意，“短文在练习上面”且用介词above表达，说明是在不接触练习的上方，不一定是正下方，可换位表述为“练习在这篇短文下面”，不接触的下方可用介词below/under表达。不同之处在于under为正下方，below不一定为正下方。

q.stem: Go straight ____ that door ____ the EXIT sign.
q.analysis: 门是一个立体空间，故“穿过”门，应用介词through表达；门是在出口标志的“正下方”，所以用介词under，故选B。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。
他的朋友遍天下。
He has friends ________ ________ ________ ________.
（本题共 4 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: all over/around the world，“全世界，全天下”，固定搭配。

q.stem: The groundwater is only a foot ____ the city streets.
q.analysis: 根据常识，地下水是在街道“下方”，用介词beneath表示，故选C。

q.stem:
选出与划线部分意思相同或相近的短语。

(2019·广东省初三期末) I am afraid we have to wait because two girls are ahead of us.
q.analysis: better than“好于……”；next to“靠近，在......旁边”；in front of“在......前面”。分析句子可知，ahead of翻译为“在……前面”，故选C。

q.stem: (2014·广东省初三期末) Mary sits ____ the classroom and I sit ____ her.
q.options:
["

in the front of; in the front of

","

in front of; in front of

","

in the front of; in front of

","

in front of; in the front of

"]
q.analysis: 这两个词组都是“在......前面”的意思，但它们之间有一些区别。in front of指“物体外部的前面”；in the front of指“物体内部的前面”，即在参照物的里面。根据句意，选C。

q.stem: When lightning flashes, it's dangerous to stay ____ the tree.
q.analysis: 表示“在树下”，通常用under the tree。选项A表示“在树上”，句意不符；选项B的beneath表示“紧贴在某物之下”，句意不符；选项C的below虽然也表示“在……之下”，但通常不用于“在树下”。

q.stem: We can see a river running to the east ____ the hill.
q.analysis: 根据语境可以知道这句话要表达的意思是一条小河从哪流过山。under 基本都是在一个大平面下，比如under a table,可排除；below“(指位置)在...下面；到...下面”；over “在什么的正上方悬挂”，可以形容彩虹之类的；on表示在某事物的表面。根据句意，只能选B。

q.stem: Do you see the kite flying ____ the building?
q.analysis: over 表示“垂直在上面”,比如 a bridge over the river； cross“横过,交叉” ；on“在……之上,物体之间有接触”；above“在……的上方”,物体之间无接触。在建筑物上方的风筝，强调在上方，故选D。

m.title: 地点方位介词辨析2 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

易混易错

q.stem: (2017·江苏苏州中考真题) Nora opened the box. To her surprise, ____ it was a gold watch.
q.analysis: outside“在外面”；inside“在里面”；beside“在旁边”；behind“在后面”。根据Nora opened the box可知金表在盒子里面，用inside，选B。

q.stem:
(2016·陕西中考真题) 根据汉语意思完成句子。

窗户旁边有一架钢琴。

There is a piano ________.
q.analysis: 根据中英文对比可知，此空须对“窗户旁边”进行翻译。by (the side of)/beside均可表示“在……旁边”，故填by (the side of)/beside the window。

q.stem:
(2016·天津中考真题) 根据汉语意思完成句子，每空一词。

他旁边的那位女士是我的姑姑莉兹。

The woman ________ ________ him is my aunt Liz.

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据中英文对比可知，此空须对“旁边”进行翻译，用短语next to；the woman作为主语，后面用介词短语next to him作为后置定语修饰主语，故答案是next to。

q.stem: The Global Theatre is ____ my home. It takes me several minutes to get there by bike.
q.analysis: 根据句意，“骑自行车要几分钟”，说明不能用表示“就在旁边/隔壁”的beside和next to，用near（附近）最符合句意。

q.stem: She sat beside me, so we became good friends.
q.options:
["

in front of

","

next to

","

behind

","

across from

"]
q.analysis: A. in front of“在……前面”；B. next to“在……旁边”；C. behind“在……后面”；D. across from“在……对面”，beside意为“在……旁边”，与 next to 意思最相近，故选B。

q.stem: Rainbow Shopping Centre is far from my home. The underlined part(划线部分) means ____.
q.options:
["

far away

","

nearby

","

not near

","

close to

"]
q.analysis: 本题主要考查同义短语。A. far away“在远处”，后须接from才可以接地点，故排除；B. nearby“在附近”；C. not near不在附近；D. close to在近处；凑近地。划线处far from 意为“远离”，与not near(不在附近)的意思相近，故选C。

q.stem:
-Open the box and you will see what is ____ it.

-OK, pass me the scissors first.
q.analysis: before“在......之前”；under“在......下面”；inside“在......里面”。根据题干Open the box可知打开之后就会看到里面装的是什么，故选C。

q.stem:
-Excuse me, where is the hotel?

-It's across ____ the bank, two kilometers away ____ here.
q.options:
["

behind; to

","

from; from

","

between; from

","

to; of

"]
q.analysis: behind“在……后面”； across from“在……对面”； between“在两者之间”；... away from“离……有多远”。根据语境及用法判断选B。

q.stem: I don't want Jimmy to be my deskmate. He's too noisy. Amy is the suitable one to sit ____ me.
q.analysis: 根据句意，坐在我旁边的人和我是同桌的关系，也就是紧挨着坐，所以用next to或beside。

q.stem: You can park your car ____ our house.
q.analysis: on“在……上”； at“在（某处）”；outside“在……外面”；inside“在……里面”。车应该是停在房子外面，故选C。

q.stem: Mrs King put some money ____ the beggar when walking past him.
q.options:
["

over

","

with

","

behind

","

beside

"]
q.analysis: over“在……上方”；with“和……一起”； behind“在……后面”； beside“在......旁边”。根据walking past him可知此处表示路过他，因此把钱放在他身边，故选D。

m.title: 地点方位介词辨析3 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

inside/outside

易混易错

q.stem:
(2019·湖北省中考真题) -I never see Linda take a taxi to work.

-To live a low-carbon life, she always goes to work ____ her bike instead of ____ taxi.
q.analysis: “by+交通工具”表示“乘坐某种交通工具”；on one's bike表示“骑自行车”。分析句子，第一空用on，第二空用by，故选B。

q.stem: (2018·山东省中考真题) Students here often do physics experiments ____ small groups.
q.analysis: 常用词组in groups表示“成群结队地；以小组为单位”，故选B。

q.stem: (2018·黑龙江省中考真题) ____ convenient the way is! We can pay money ____ scanning QR codes (二维码) in many shops.
q.analysis: 前句是感叹句，中心词是形容词convenient，应用句式“How+形容词/副词+主语+谓语!”，第一空用how；后句意为“我们可以在许多商店通过扫描二维码来付钱”，介词by可表示“通过某种方式”，故选：B。

q.stem: (2019·河北省中考真题) This story is ____ simple English. My little sister can read it.
q.analysis: “in+某种语言”表示“用某种语言”，故选B。

q.stem: (2015·江苏镇江中考真题) Ma Yun, the Chairperson of Alibaba Group, has made much money ____ the Internet.
q.analysis: through“通过”，常指通过某种途径、手段；along“沿着”；across“穿过”；towards“朝，向”。根据句意推测，马云通过网络挣了很多钱，应选A。

q.stem: (2014·浙江丽水中考真题) ____ his pocket money, Dan bought a present for his mother on Mother's Day.
q.analysis: with“和，用”；for“为了”；by“通过某种方式”；in“在……里面”；根据句意，丹用零花钱给妈妈买礼物，故选A。

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。
I saw the great changes ________ my own eyes.
q.analysis: 我亲眼看到这些巨大的变化，with my own eyes表示“亲眼，用自己的眼睛看”。

q.stem: Lin Lin often practices English ____ chatting with her American friend.
q.analysis: 通过某种方式可用介词“by”，句中是用与美国朋友聊天的方式练习英语。

q.stem: More and more people in Shanghai choose to go to work ____ underground and go sightseeing ____ coach.
q.analysis: 考查交通方式介词辨析。by 后接交通工具或与交通工具相关的名词；in 后接限定词，再接交通工具，表示“在......里”；on 后接限定词，再接交通工具，表示“在......上”（on foot 除外）。underground（地铁）和coach（长途客车）都是交通工具，且前无限定词，故都搭配介词by, 答案为C。

q.stem: In Brazil, you should wipe your mouth ____ your napkin every time you take a drink.
q.analysis: 根据语境可知，此处表示“用你的餐巾擦嘴”，是表达擦嘴的方式，而A选项for通常表示原因或目的，故排除A。BCD都可以表示方式，不同的是，B选项on常与电视、录音机、电话、网络连用；D选项in后接某种语言或材料；两者都不符合。只有C选项with后接限定词，再接具体的工具或方法，符合题意，故选C。

q.stem: China can ____ programmes ____ radio or TV to the other side of the world with the help of man-made satellites.
q.options:
["

send out; on

","

send up; by

","

put up; through

","

set up; over

"]
q.analysis: send out动词短语，意为“发出、发送”；send up“发射、使向上升”； put up“张贴、挂起”； set up“建立、设立”。介词on/by/through/over都表示“通过……方式”，但有一定区别。只有on 常与电视、录音机、电话、网络连用，符合题意，故选A。

q.stem: (2018·江苏省初三专题练习) The Smiths talked happily ____ a loud voice when they went on a trip ____ their family car.
q.analysis: 考查方式介词。介词in 后接某种语言或材料，与“a...voice”可搭配为固定词组，表示“以……的嗓音”，故排除BC；by 与in 都可表示交通方式，不同的是，by后直接接交通工具或与交通工具相关的名词，而in 后须接限定词，再接交通工具，此处交通工具car前有限定词，故选D。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。

直到19世纪之前，所有的布料都是手工制作的。

Until the nineteenth century, all cloth was made ________ hand.
q.analysis: 根据中英文提示，此处表达“用手工制作”，其所在句不缺少谓语动词且空后接名词hand, 故判断这里缺少一个介词，by hand 意为“用手工制作”，故答案为by。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。

中国人常以盛宴款待宾客。

Chinese people usually ________ their guests ________ a big meal.

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据中英文提示可知，这里缺少"以......款待"，分析句子结构，可知此句缺少谓语，故空一用动词treat表达“款待”，句子主语是复数名词people，所以这里用动词原形，“用......”可搭配介词with，所以本题答案为treat，with。

m.title: 方式介词辨析 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

表示“交通方式”: by/in/on

知识拓展

q.stem: (2018·河南省中考真题) I stopped ____ the night in a small village while I was on holiday in the Himalayas a few years ago.
q.analysis: at“在（某处）”；for“为了”；until“直到”；through“通过”。根据I stopped ____ the night in a small village可知“我”停下来的目的是为了过夜，for可表示目的，故选B。

q.stem:
(2018·广东省中考模拟) 选出与画线部分意思相近或相同的选项。

-As a result of playing computer games too much, Michael is near-sighted and has to wear glasses.

-It's difficult for youngsters to stay away from games.
q.analysis: thanks to“由于，多亏”；result in“导致”；because of“因为，由于”。画线部分as a result of意为“由于，作为……的结果”，与because of意思类似，故答案是C。

q.stem:
(2016·甘肃省中考真题) -Alice , would you like to go hiking with us?

-What a pity! I am free every day ____ today.
q.analysis: for后跟时间段；except“除了”，指在整体当中去除一部分；besides“除了什么之外，还有”，指包含在内；among“在三者或三者以上之间”。本题意思是“除了今天没空，其它天都有空”，指的是“在整体当中去除”的意思，except正是此意；故选B。

q.stem:
(2017·湖北省中考真题) -Do you have anything else to say for being late again?

-No, nothing ____ sorry．
q.analysis: 根据语境可推测答句意思是“除了对不起没有其它可说的了”，词组nothing but意为“除……而外，什么也没有；只有”，故but符合句意；above“在……上面”；behind“在……后面”；from“从”；答案是D。

q.stem: (2016·山东省中考真题) ____ running after success, we have a lot of other interesting things to do in our lives.
q.analysis: by“通过某种方式”；on“在……上面，关于”；besides“除了……之外”（指包括在内）；except“除了……之外”（指排除在外）。人生中有趣的事情应该包括成功，选C。

q.stem: (2014·四川遂宁中考真题) ____ free education, more and more poor children can go back to school in the mountain.
q.analysis: without“没有”；thanks to“多亏，由于”；instead of“而不是”。分析句意可知前后句为因果关系，由于有义务教育，所以山区贫困孩子可以重返学校，选B。

q.stem: Her composition (作文) is better than any other student's in her class ____ some spelling mistakes.
q.analysis: besides表示累加关系，“除……之外，还有……”；except和but都表示排除关系，“除……外，不再有……”，但but侧重意义的几乎完整性，except侧重后面除去的部分；与上述三者不同，except for后所排除的是不同类的东西，表示在说明情况后作细节上的修正。本题中被排除的some spelling mistakes和composition不同类，故选A。

q.stem:
改为同义句，每空一词。
I was the only person who was invited to the party.
Nobody ________ ________ was invited to the party.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: 根据句意，“除了我，没有人被邀请”，可知这里“除了”表示排除在外，应用介词except或but，故填入except/but me。

q.stem: The English teacher is popular among the students. Because she also has many good qualities (品质) ____ her excellent ability to teach.
q.analysis: besides表示累加关系，“除……之外，还有……”；except和but都表示排除关系，“除……外，不再有……”，但but侧重意义的几乎完整性，except侧重后面除去的部分；与上述三者不同，except for后所排除的是不同类的东西，表示在说明情况后作细节上的修正。根据句意，“优秀的教学能力”也是包含在内的，故选B。

q.stem: The foreign woman is known ____ beautiful art pieces.
q.analysis: be known as“作为……而著名”，后面一般跟职业；be known for“因……而著名”，后面一般跟原因；结合选项可知，这里用到be known for making意思是因制作美丽的艺术品而著名，故选B。

q.stem: We all ____ Mrs. Wang ____ her help. ____ her help, we have made great success.
q.options:
["

thank; for; Thanks to

","

thank; to; Thanks for

","

thank; for; Thanks for

","

thank; to; Thanks to

"]
q.analysis: 动词短语thank...for...意为“因......而感谢......”；介词短语thanks to 意为“由于， 多亏”。根据句意及结构，空一缺少谓语动词，故空一空二用thank...for ...；空三后接名词短语her help，表示我们取得巨大成功的原因，故用Thanks to，答案为A。

q.stem: He didn't go to the cinema not ____ the weather, but ____ he didn't want to see the film.
q.options:
["

because of; because

","

because; because of

","

because; because 

","

because of; because of

"]
q.analysis: because与because of都可表示原因，不同之处在于because 后接从句构成原因状语从句，because of 后接名词或名词性结构，构成表示原因的介词短语。空一后接名词，故用 because of，空二后接从句，故用because引导。故答案为A。

q.stem:
选择与划线部分意思相同或相近的一项。

Thanks to your help, we can finish the work on time.
q.options:
["

Thanks for

","

Thanks

","

Because

","

Because of

"]
q.analysis: thanks to意为“由于；多亏”，其中 to 为介词，后需接名词性成分，B选项thanks为名词，C 选项because引导原因状语从句，都不符合，故排除。A选项 Thanks for 意为“因为......而感谢”，意思不符，故答案选D. Because of 意为“由于”，与thanks to 意思和用法相近。

q.stem:
-Thanks ____ our government, we can play sports on the new playground next week.

-That's for sure! And we'll have a sports meeting ____ one month.
q.options:
["

for; in

","

to; in

","

for; after

","

to; after

"]
q.analysis: thanks for 表示“因......而感谢”，thanks to 表示“幸亏，由于”，根据句一可知是“多亏”政府，可以在新操场上做运动，故用thanks to, 排除A、C；after +时间段，通常用于过去时态，此处是一般将来时，需用in+时间段，故答案为B。

q.stem: She won an Oscar ____ Best Actress ____ her role ____ this film.
q.options:
["

of; for; in

","

for; of; of

","

for; for; in

","

of; of; in

"]
q.analysis: 考查介词。an Oscar for 意为“奥斯卡的......奖”，故排除A、D；空二表示原因，后接名词短语her role，故用for；空三表达“在这部电影里的”，介词短语作her role的定语，“在……里”用介词in，故答案为C。

q.stem: The accident was due ____ careless driving. That was too terrible!
q.analysis: 根据句意及结构，careless driving 为名词性结构，是事故造成的原因，due搭配介词to构成介词短语due to，表示“由......造成”，强调造成后果的原因。

q.stem: (2018·上海初三二模 ) I apologized to the teacher ____ not finishing the exercises in time.
q.analysis: 考查介词。for“因为”，可以表示原因；at“在......”，时间介词或地点介词；as“作为”；of“……的”，表示所属关系。根据句意可知，道歉的原因是“没能及时完成练习”。故选A。

m.title: 因果/包括/排除介词辨析 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

因果介词辨析

易混易错

包括/排除介词辨析

包括/排除介词辨析

q.stem:
(2014·湖北鄂州中考真题) -She sold her treasures to cure her mother's illness, even though it was ____ her own wishes.

-It's so kind ____ her.
q.analysis: 由上句中的even though可推知她违背了自己的心愿去卖了珠宝，against意为“违背”， 符合第一空；第二空为句型“It's+表性格、品质的形容词+of+sb. to do sth.”表示“某人做某事真是太……了”，所以用of。故选A。

q.stem: (2019·内蒙古呼和浩特中考真题) Ben was helping his mother when the rain began to beat heavily ____ the windows．
q.analysis: against“碰，撞”；across“穿过”；above“在……上面”；below“在……下面”。这里指大雨敲打窗户，应用against，选A。

q.stem: (2018·北京中考真题) Happy birthday, Peter! Here's a gift ____ you.
q.analysis: 根据句意可知应该选择for，意为“给”，表示送礼物的对象。选A。

q.stem:
(2019·福建中考真题) -Is that your headmaster?

-You mean the man ____ blue?
q.analysis: “in+颜色”表示“穿着某种颜色的衣服”，故选C。

q.stem:
根据首字母提示填空，每空一词。

The sound of the rain beating a________ the windows makes me feel upset.
q.analysis: 此处缺介词，根据句意和首字母a，可知是against，意为“反对，倚，靠”，或表示“雨打在物体上”，故答案为against。

q.stem: Will you get two tickets ____ the match ____ me?
q.analysis: 考查介词辨析。根据句意判断，空一表示“关于”比赛，空二表示“为”我，都需要用介词for。故答案为C。

q.stem: Smartphones are used ____ young people to shop online.
q.analysis: 考查be used 的介词搭配及辨析。根据空前部分句意可判断出be used为被动语态结构，young people是动作的实施者，应由介词by引出。故答案为C。

q.stem:
(2020·全国初三课时练习) -Is it necessary ____ us ____ some photos before saving the old man?

-Yes, it is. We can protect ourselves if we do so.
q.options:
["

of; taking

","

for; taking

","

of; to take

","

for; to take

"]
q.analysis: 根据It is adj. for/of sb to do sth可知，第二空处用 to take，排除A和B；若用for sb时，形容词修饰 to do sth，若用of sb时，形容词修饰sb，表示某人的品质、性格等。根据句意可知，necessary修饰to take some photos before saving the old man，用for，故选D。

q.stem: I am not sure who the shoes with special heels were invented ____, but I know they are used ____ the styles of the shoes.
q.options:
["

/; change 

","

/; to change 

","

by; to changing

","

by; for changing

"]
q.analysis: 在l am not sure who the shoes with special heels were invented ____ 中who是动作invent的发出者，在被动结构中经常用by+动作的逻辑主语，故第一空填写by；be used for doing sth“被用来做某事”，故选D。

q.stem: (2018·江苏省南通第一初中初三期末) The Math teacher found ____ was quite cleverer ____ him to work out the problem.
q.analysis: 根据句意及句子结构，空二前的cleverer 是描述him所具有的品质，因此空二应填入of，进而判断found 后接宾语从句符合it + be+形容词+of sb. to do sth.的形容词句型，故空一应填it，作宾语从句的形式主语，答案为D。

q.stem: (2019·江苏省初三期末) When I was a kid ____ your age, I tried out ____ our school volleyball team.
q.options:
["

at; for 

","

of; of 

","

in; in

","

of; for

"]
q.analysis: 考查介词。根据I和your可判断，不是同一个人，故用of one's age结构，表示“和某人年龄相仿时”，故排除AC。短语 try out for 表示“参加……选拔”，故选D。

q.stem: (2019·湖北省江夏一中中考模拟) Jim isn't from a poor family, yet he often comes to school wearing the same clothes every day ____ the week.
q.analysis: 考查介词。结合句意及转折连词 yet 可知，Jim应是一周的每一天都穿着相同，every day 与 week 两者是所属关系，应用介词of连接。every day of the week“一周的每一天”，答案为C。

q.stem:
根据中文提示填空，每空一词。

I have nothing ________ (反对) square dancing as long as they don't make too much noise.
q.analysis: 根据汉语提示及句子结构，空格后接名词短语square dancing，所在句子不缺少谓语，故应选用介词，介词against 表示“反对”。

q.stem:
-I think it's polite ____ the young to offer seats to the old.

-Yeah, and it's necessary ____ us to do so.
q.options:
["

of; for

","

of; of 

","

for; of

","

for; for

"]
q.analysis: 根据结构判断，空一所在宾语从句与空二所在句皆为形容词句型，it作形式宾语，根据句意判断，空一前的polite是描述人the young的品质，故用介词of，排除CD；空二前的necessary是描述事物to do so的性质，故用介词for。故答案为A。

m.title: 介词的其他用法1 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

by/against

with/wihtout

of/for

易混易错

in

易混易错

q.stem: (2019·浙江温州中考真题) The instructions tell us everything ____ about how to make the model ship.
q.analysis: by hand“用手”；by chance“偶然地”；in detail“详细地”；in person“亲自地”。根据语境关于如何制作模型船，可知说明书会“详细地”告诉我们，C符合题意。

q.stem: (2019·重庆中考真题) I enjoy talking with my classmates ____ our way to school.
q.analysis: on one's way to表示“在去……的路上”，是固定搭配，故选A。

q.stem: (2019·山西中考真题) Change the information you read into a mind map. ____, you can remember it well and think of it later easily.
q.options:
["

In this way

","

At the same time

","

On the other hand

"]
q.analysis: in this way“用这种方法”；at the same time“同时”；on the other hand“另一方面”。根据句意可知设空处表示“用这种方法”，选A。

q.stem:
(2016·宁夏中考真题) -Have you got the answer ____ the question?

-Not yet.
q.analysis: 结合空前的the answer和空后的the question可以推断这句话的意思是“你得到那个问题的答案了吗”，词组the answer to意为“……的答案”，故选D。

q.stem: (2017·山西中考真题) When you're invited to have dinner at home by an American friend，you should be ____ or a little later．It's different from our Chinese custom．
q.analysis: on time“准时”；on business“出差”；on show“展出”。根据语境及关键词or a little later可知此处指的是“准时到”，选A。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填入适当的单词，每空一词。
Bill Gates and Steve Jobs were as different as night and day, yet they ________ much ________ ________(有共同之处).
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: have...in common表示“有共同点”，是固定搭配。

q.stem: Guangzhou is famous ____ its beautiful flowers in China.
q.analysis: be famous for 后一般跟事物 ,表“因/由于……而闻名”。

q.stem: The children are interested ____ this subject.
q.analysis: be interested in是“对…感兴趣”。句中是对这个学科感兴趣。

q.stem: In my opinion, I agree ____ you ____ your arrangement (安排).
q.analysis: agree with sb. .意为“同意；（与某人）意见一致”；agree to sth，表示“同意某一方的建议、安排、计划”; agree on，表示“就……问题，多方达成一致意见”。因此选B。

q.stem: When the teacher heard us talking in class, he was very angry ____ us.
q.analysis: be angry with+某人指“生...某人的气”，句中是对我们生气。

q.stem: I am familiar ____ this school since I have worked here for more than fifteen years.
q.analysis: be familiar to sb. 指“对某人熟悉”；be familiar with sth.指“对某事物熟悉”。句中是对学校熟悉，所以选介词“with”。

q.stem: Don't laugh ____ him, he only made a small mistake.
q.analysis: laugh at指“嘲笑某人”，这里是指不要嘲笑他。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填入适当的单词，每空一词。
I have a lot of problems to ________ ________(处理).
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: deal with表示“解决”，to引导动词不定式，后面动词用原型，所以填deal with。

q.stem:
根据汉语意思填入适当的单词，每空一词。
Please ________ ________(回复) me as soon as possible.
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis: reply to表示“回复某人”。

q.stem: ____ average, I spend 100 yuan on books each month.
q.analysis: on average“平均,按平均数计算;一般地说”，是固定搭配。

q.stem:
用适当的介词填空。
I will always help my friends when they are ________ trouble.
q.analysis: be in trouble“处于危险、困难、痛苦之中”，是固定搭配。

m.title: 介词搭配 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

考点解读

介词+名词

介词+名词

介词+名词

介词+名词

名词+介词

名词+介词

动词+介词

动词+介词

be+形容词+介词

be+形容词+介词

其他

其他

q.stem: (2017·辽宁沈阳中考真题) ____ 2000, this company has seen much new development. It has become one of the biggest companies in the country.
q.analysis: for后接时间段，用于完成时态或一般过去时；in后接时间段，用于一般将来时；by后接时间点，常用于过去完成时或将来完成时；since后接时间点，常用于现在完成时。此处的2000是时间点，且由has seen可知时态是现在完成时，选D。

q.stem: (2017·河南中考真题) Father brought his little boy to a concert. But he was too young to sit ____ the whole concert.
q.analysis: 介词through意为“由始至终，一直到底”，词组sit through意为“坐着挨到（电影、讲座、会议等）结束”，故选D。

q.stem: (2014·山东威海中考真题) We are leaving tomorrow. We will be away ____ next Friday.
q.analysis: 前句说“我们明天就离开了”，后句描述离开的状态，空后的next Friday是未来的时间点，可推知“我们从明天一直到下周五都在外面”，是一种持续的状态；until意为“直到”，表示动作、状态的延续，符合题意。选B。

q.stem: (2018·河南省初三期末) The housing price in my hometown has increased by two percent ____ the past two months.
q.analysis: during“在……期间”；till“直到”；at表时间，指“在具体的某时刻”；on表时间，指“在（某一天）”。题干中the past two months表示一段时间，只有during可后接时间段；其它介词表示时间点，不能与一段时间连用。且“during+时间段”可用于现在完成时，符合本题，故选A。

q.stem: It is around half an hour ____ the sports meeting began.
q.analysis: 表示“自从某事开始”用since。since译为“自从”时，从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时或一般现在时。选项B的when所在的主句通常和从句时态一致；选项C的at后不加从句；选项D的for可译为“因为”，句意不符。

q.stem: Mr. Brown had lain ____ the ground ____ four hours before they finally found him.
q.analysis: on the ground表示“在地上，在现场”； “for+时间段”表示某事持续了多长时间，与完成时连用，表示已经躺了四个小时。

q.stem: Edwin was giving a speech about his inventions ____ seven ____ nine last Sunday evening.
q.analysis: “from +具体时间+ to +具体时间”表示“从某时到某时”，搭配延续性动词或状态。

q.stem: Would you please look ____ my baby girl ____ my absence?
q.analysis: look after“照顾”；look for“寻找”；look to“注意”；during“在……期间”；“in+时间段”表示“一段时间内/后”。during my absence意为“我不在的时候”；结合句意，“我不在的时候，照顾我的小女儿”，用look after，选A。

q.stem:
(2019·河北初三期末) -Can I go to the hospital to see Grandma now?

-No, you can't. It's ____ the visiting hours. Let's see Grandma tomorrow. She won't mind that.
q.analysis: on表时间，指“在（某一天）”；over“在……之上”；during“在……期间”；beyond“超过”。根据“你不能”及“我们明天去看望奶奶吧”，可以推测出“已超过了拜访时间”，用beyond，选D。

q.stem: (2017·安庆四中月考) It ____ discovered ____ the 17th century.
q.analysis: 根据语义可知，主语与谓语之间是被动关系，因而使用被动语态：be+动词的过去分词；discovered是discover的过去分词，be动词用wasn't，选A。

q.stem: (2018·江苏扬州中学初二单元测试) I have to work ____ the whole winter vacation. Just no fun at all!
q.analysis: 根据Just no fun at all可推知上句意思是“我整个寒假都得工作”，结合选项，through可表示“自始至终；从头到尾”，符合句意。across“横穿”；at“在”；on“在……上”。选A。

q.stem: I worked on the problem ____ a long time and I worked it out ____ myself ____ last.
q.options: ["for; by; at","in; with; on","on; by; in","for; for; at the"]
q.analysis: for a long time 很久；by oneself 某人自己；at last 最后。

m.title: 时间介词辨析2 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

时间起点：from/since

时间结点：by/until

q.stem: (2019·江苏省中考真题) Let's take a walk ____ the river after diner, shall we?
q.analysis: along“沿着”；through“穿过”；upon“在……上”；over“在……上面”。根据常识可知沿着河流散步，用介词along，选A。

q.stem: (2019·内蒙古包头中考真题) He drove so fast at the turn that the car almost went ____ the road.
q.analysis: 根据常识，转弯处车速过快会使车子偏离道路，off作介词可表示“离开，偏离”，符合句意。on“在……上面”；along“沿着”；behind“在……后面”都不符合语境。选A。

q.stem: (2017·甘肃省中考模拟) It's reported that the sand storm's moving ____ the southern part of China.
q.analysis: beside“在旁边”；with“伴随，用”；below“在……下方”；towards“朝，向”。结合语境可知选D。

q.stem:
(2016·湖北鄂州中考真题) -Oh, my god! I've left my keys in the room. I'll have to get in ____ the window.

-It's dangerous. You'd better wait for your mom to come back.
q.analysis: past“（从旁边）经过”；over“从（较高的物体）上方越过”；across“穿过，横穿”，表示从物体表面穿过；through“透过，穿过”，表示从立体的物体中穿过。“从窗户翻进去”应用介词through，选D。

q.stem: ____ June 9th, he helped a man ____ a fire.
q.options:
["

In; into

","

On; out of

","

In; out of

","

On; into

"]
q.analysis: 表示在具体的某一天要用介词on，故空一为 On，排除AC；根据helped a man可知应是从火中救出来，out of 表示“出来”，故选B。help sb. out of “将某人从......救出来”。

q.stem: (2020·广西壮族自治区初三其他) When I saw Alice waiting for me at the gate of the zoo, I walked ____ her quickly.
q.analysis: 考查介词辨析。at“在(时刻、年龄等)”；for“为了”； towards“朝；向”；without“没有”。根据句中“When I saw Alice waiting for me”可知，此处是“当我看见爱丝正在等我时，我快速地朝她走去”。表示朝向，故选C。

q.stem:
-Is there a fruit shop ____ the neighborhood?

-Yes, it's ____ Center Street ____ the right.
q.options:
["

on; on; in

","

in; on; in

","

on; down; to

","

in; down; on

"]
q.analysis: 考查介词辨析。空一 in the neighborhood意为“在附近”，故排除AC；空二，如表达在中央大街，须用介词in；如表达“沿着中心街直走”则用down；on无法搭配，故排除B；on the right 表示“在右边”，进一步判断答案为D。

q.stem: Bill and Joe have decided to spend the May Day holiday on an island which lies ____ the coast of France.
q.analysis: off the coast of France“远离法国海岸”，根据常识可知，岛都是远离海岸的，介词off可表示“离开”，故选D。

q.stem:
(2019·南京师范大学附属中学江宁分校初三开学考试) 根据括号内所给中文提示填空，每空一词。

The sweet memories of summer days are about walking ________ (沿着) Boai Road with trees and shade to feel cool.
q.analysis: 分析句子结构，根据题干中“walking ________ Boai Road”可推知此处要用介词，“沿着”译为“along”。故答案为along。

q.stem: (2016·全国初三单元测试) Sean has formed the habit of jogging ____ the tree-lined avenue for two hours every day.
q.analysis: 考查介词辨析。根据句意推知Sean 是“沿着”大道慢跑，A选项between表示“在（两者）之间”，B选项along 表示“沿着”，C选项below表示在不接触物体表面的下方，D选项with表示“和；有；附带”，故B选项符合。

q.stem: When he walked ____ my desk, he knocked my books ____ the floor.
q.analysis: 分析句子结构，When引导的时间状语从句不缺少谓语，又根据空一后的名词短语，可以判断需用介词；分析句意，空一处表示“经过”。pass作“经过”讲，为动词词性，故排除AC。onto“到……之上”；into“进入……中”。根据floor（地面）可知空二用onto，故选B。

q.stem: (2020·江苏省初三其他) If success is a gate, the road ____ this gate must be made up of difficulties.
q.analysis: A.朝；向；B.反对；C.在……对面；D.超越。根据句意可知，表示“通往成功的道路”，故选A。

q.stem: (2015·江苏省初三月考) ____ I took the brush away, I dropped some paint ____ the paper.
q.analysis: when，while和as引导时间状语从句。as引导时间状语从句，意思是“随着”，表示动作在某个时间点同时发生，通常放在句首；when引导的时间状语从句既可表示“时间点"，也可表示“一段时间”；while只能表示“一段时间”，它引导的从句中谓语动词必须用延续性动词；since引导的时间状语从句，意为“自从......以后”，动词可以是延续性动词，也可以是终止性动词，onto在意上相当于to+on，即表示某物向另一物运动(to)，然后停落在另一物之上(on)。故选A。

q.stem: In Brazil, you should wipe your mouth ____ your napkin every time you take a drink.
q.analysis: 根据语境可知，此处表示“用你的餐巾擦嘴”，是表达擦嘴的方式，而A选项for通常表示原因或目的，故排除A。BCD都可以表示方式，不同的是，B选项on常与电视、录音机、电话、网络连用；D选项in后接某种语言或材料；两者都不符合。只有C选项with后接限定词，再接具体的工具或方法，符合题意，故选C。

q.stem: (2019·无锡市江南中学初三中考) Hearing the shout for help, little Jack jumped ____ the rubbish bin and rushed out of the room.
q.analysis: into“进去”，out“出去”，over“在……上方”，off“下，离开”。根据句意可知，这里表示“从垃圾桶上方跳过”，故选C。

m.title: 地点方位介词辨析4 · 讲义
m.body:
封面

to/toward(s)

up/down/along

易混易错

q.stem: ____ will the weather be ____ in Hainan in December?
q.options:
["

How; like

","

What; like 

","

How's; /

","

What; /

"]
q.analysis:
表达“......会怎么样？”可用 what will...be like? 或 How......will be? 。be like“像”，其中like是介词，可接名词性成分作宾语，故只可用疑问代词 what 提问。故答案选B。


【翻译/释义】海南十二月的天气会怎么样？

q.stem: Joyce wrote an article ____ how to improve our memory.
q.analysis:
考查介词辨析。根据how to improve our memory可知，“如何提高记忆力”是这篇文章的相关内容，用on表示“关于”，故选B。


【翻译/释义】乔伊斯写了一篇关于如何提高记忆力的文章。

q.stem:
完成句子，每空一词。

You can't just leave ________ saying anything. You are supposed to attend the meeting.
q.analysis:
分析句子结构，空格前为谓语动词，可知句子不缺少谓语，又根据空格后的动名词短语可判断空格处须填入介词。根据句意，“不能什么也不说”符合逻辑，故用介词without，意为“没有”。


【翻译/释义】你不能什么也不说就离开。你应该参加这个会议。

q.stem: (2019·广东中考真题) I think tea will taste better ____ some milk in it.
q.analysis:
根据语境及常识，我们可推测句意为“我认为茶里加些牛奶会更好喝”，介词with可表示“有，带有”，符合句意。for“为了”；from“从”；at“在（某处）”。选B。


【翻译/释义】我认为茶里加些牛奶会更好喝。

q.stem:
(2014·江苏连云港中考真题) -A person's life is like a road ____ lots of difficulties．

-Yes, so we need positive energy.
q.analysis:
by“在……旁边”；with“带有”；along“沿着”；during“在……期间”。由下句Yes可知说话人同意对方观点并补充说需要正能量，可推知上句描述人生跟辛，即是带有困难的道路，with符合句意，故选B。


【翻译/释义】-人的一生就像一条充满困难的道路。 -是的，所以我们需要正能量。

q.stem:
翻译句子，每空一词。

杰克没有敲门就进了我的房间。

Jack went into my room ________ ________ ________ the door.
q.analysis:
动词短语knock at/on意为“敲（门、窗等）”，此处句子已有谓语动词went，所以后面用without短语表示“没有......”，作状语；且介词without后面动词knock需用doing形式，故填without；knocking；at/on。


【翻译/释义】略

q.stem:
用适当的介词完成句子，每空一词。

The twins looked at each other and kept it ________ a secret to themselves.
q.analysis:
考查介词。根据句意可知，双胞胎把它当作为秘密，此处表示“作为……”，as介词，作为……，符合题意，故填as。


【翻译/释义】这对双胞胎互相看着，把它当作自己的秘密，对别人保密。
